words.ex: He is a big potato in the tech industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在科技行业是个大人物。
words.en: An important or influential person.

words.tr: phrase. 一部票房很成功的电影
words.ex: The new movie was a box office smash.
words.ex_cn: 这部新电影是一部票房大卖的影片。
words.en: A very successful theatrical or film production that earns a large amount of money.

words.ex: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
words.ex_cn: 他送给她一束花。
words.en: A large number or quantity of something.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.ex: The hovercraft moves on a cushion of air.
words.ex_cn: 气垫船在一层空气垫上移动。
words.en: A layer of air that supports something, such as a vehicle, above a surface.

words.ex: There is a heavy demand for fresh vegetables in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上对新鲜蔬菜的需求很大。
words.en: A strong need or desire for something, often more than what is available.

words.ex: A host of students came to the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生来听讲座了。
words.en: A large number of something.

words.tr: phrase. （某事肯定发生只是）时间问题
words.ex: It is just a matter of time before he passes the test.
words.ex_cn: 他通过考试只是时间问题。
words.en: If you say that something is just a matter of time, you mean that it will definitely happen, though you cannot be sure exactly when.

words.ex: There is a multitude of birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 公园里有大量鸟类。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.tr: phrase. 一块蛋糕； 一件轻松的事
words.ex: He gave me a piece of cake at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上给了我一块蛋糕。
words.en: If you think something is very easy to do, you can say it is a piece of cake.

words.ex: He has a range of hobbies, like swimming and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有很多爱好，比如游泳和画画。
words.en: A variety or assortment of things.

words.tr: phrase. 一连串的；一系列；一套
words.ex: He made a series of mistakes on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一连串的错误。
words.en: A number of things or events that are arranged or happen one after the other.

words.ex: He has a set of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他书架上有一套书。
words.en: A group of similar things that belong together or are used together.

words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的清洁用水不足。
words.en: A shortage is a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.

words.ex: He ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A portion or piece of something, especially food, that has been cut or separated from the whole.

words.ex: He speaks a sort of broken English.
words.ex_cn: 他说的是一种破烂的英语。
words.en: A sort of is used to indicate that something is similar to but not exactly the same as the thing mentioned.

words.ex: The park is a stone's throw away from my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园离我家很近。
words.en: If you say that one place is a stone's throw away from another, you mean that the two places are very close to each other.

words.tr: phrase. 恶性循环；无法摆脱的困境
words.ex: He keeps spending money and getting deeper in debt — it's a vicious circle.
words.ex_cn: 他不断花钱，债务越来越重——这就是一个恶性循环。
words.en: A situation in which one problem causes another problem, which then makes the first problem worse.

words.tr: phrase. 很多的；丰富的；大量的
words.ex: He has a wealth of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: A large amount of something valuable or useful.

words.tr: phrase. 学术氛围；学业风气
words.ex: The library has a quiet academic atmosphere.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有一种安静的学术氛围。
words.en: The environment or mood within an educational institution that is conducive to learning and scholarly activities.

words.ex: He is popular in the academic circle.
words.ex_cn: 他在学术圈里很受欢迎。
words.en: The academic circle refers to the community of scholars and researchers engaged in higher education and scholarly research.

words.tr:
n. 接触（的机会或权利）；进入；通道；
v. 获取；使用；接近；
words.ex: Students need access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 学生需要有接触图书馆的机会。
words.en: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able to enter it or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He adapts to new rules quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快适应新规则。
words.en: If you adapt to a new situation or adapt yourself to it, you change your ideas or behaviour in order to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: The numbers add up to 100.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字加起来等于100。
words.en: If amounts add up to a particular total, they result in that total when they are put together.

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To increase or enhance something by adding more to it.

words.ex: He is adept at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: Someone who is adept at something is very skilled at it.

words.ex: The house is adjacent to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子紧邻公园。
words.en: If one thing is adjacent to another, they are next to each other.

words.ex: He needs to adjust to the new school.
words.ex_cn: 他需要适应新学校。
words.en: If you adjust to a new situation or get used to it, you change your behaviour or ideas so that you can deal with it successfully.

words.ex: He goes to adult education classes after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后去参加成人教育课程。
words.en: Education provided for adults, typically outside the formal educational system, to improve their knowledge, skills, or qualifications.

words.ex: The company launched a new advertising campaign last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月推出了一项新的广告活动。
words.en: A planned series of advertisements intended to achieve a particular aim.

words.ex: He gave me advice on how to study better.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我如何更好地学习的建议。
words.en: Guidance or recommendations about a particular subject.

words.ex: The teacher showed an aerial photograph of the city.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张这座城市的航拍照片。
words.en: A photograph taken from an aircraft or satellite in flight.

words.tr: phrase. 对...达成协议；对...取得一致意见
words.ex: They agree on the plan for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们对旅行的计划达成一致。
words.en: To reach a mutual understanding or consensus about something.

words.ex: The agricultural workforce works hard in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 农业劳动力每天在田里辛勤工作。
words.en: The agricultural workforce refers to the segment of the population engaged in agricultural activities, including farming, fishing, and forestry, contributing to the production of food and other agricultural products.

words.ex: He finished his homework ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了作业。
words.en: If you do something ahead of time, you do it before a particular event or before you need to, often in order to save time later.

words.ex: We aim to help students improve their English.
words.ex_cn: 我们旨在帮助学生提高英语水平。
words.en: If you aim to do something, you intend or plan to do it.

words.ex: The room has air conditioning to keep it cool.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有空调来保持凉爽。
words.en: Air conditioning is a system or process that controls the temperature, humidity, and sometimes the purity of the air in a building or vehicle.

words.ex: All of a sudden, the dog started barking.
words.ex_cn: 突然间，狗开始叫了。
words.en: If something happens all of a sudden, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.ex: I am all set for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 我已经为旅行做好了准备。
words.en: Fully prepared or ready for something.

words.ex: People from all walks of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all walks of life are people of all types, especially all types of jobs.

words.ex: He watched an all-talking film last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚看了一部有声电影。
words.en: A film with synchronized sound, especially one in which the dialogue is entirely spoken, as opposed to silent films or films with only musical accompaniment.

words.w: alter the course of one's life
words.tr: phrase. 改变某人的人生轨道
words.uk: ˈɔːltə ðə kɔːs əv wʌnz laɪf
words.us: ˈɔːltər ðə kɔːrs əv wʌnz laɪf
words.ex: Winning the scholarship will alter the course of one's life.
words.ex_cn: 赢得这个奖学金将改变一个人的人生轨迹。
words.en: To change the direction or path of one's life in a significant way.

words.ex: The car uses alternative fuel to reduce pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用替代燃料以减少污染。
words.en: A fuel that is not derived from petroleum and is considered to be less harmful to the environment than traditional fuels.

words.tr: phrase. 其它可供选择的工作
words.ex: He chose an alternative work schedule to spend more time with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一种不同的工作时间安排，以便有更多时间陪伴家人。
words.en: Alternative work refers to a different type of employment or job that one considers or takes up instead of their current one, often due to dissatisfaction or the need for a change.

words.ex: The gym charges an annual fee of $50.
words.ex_cn: 健身房收取50美元的年费。
words.en: A yearly charge for the use of a service or membership.

words.ex: The bank says the annual interest rate is 5%.
words.ex_cn: 银行说年利率是5%。
words.en: The annual interest rate is the percentage of a sum of money that is paid as interest over the period of one year.

words.ex: He is anything but lazy.
words.ex_cn: 他绝不是懒惰的。
words.en: You use anything but in expressions such as anything but quiet and anything but happy to emphasize that something is not the case.

words.ex: He lives apart from the city noise.
words.ex_cn: 他住在远离城市喧嚣的地方。
words.en: You use apart from when you are making an exception to a general statement.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；有吸引力；使感兴趣
words.ex: The teacher appealed to the students to be quiet.
words.ex_cn: 老师呼吁学生们保持安静。
words.en: To make a serious or urgent request to the public for help or money; to attract or interest someone.

words.ex: He appears to be tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后似乎很累。
words.en: If something appears to be the way you describe it, it seems to be that way.

words.ex: He filled out the application form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了申请表。
words.en: A document used to apply for something, such as a job or membership, by providing personal information and details.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the library.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请图书馆的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: They argue over who should do the dishes.
words.ex_cn: 他们为谁该洗碗而争吵。
words.en: To argue over something means to have a disagreement or dispute about it, often involving a heated exchange of differing opinions.

words.ex: The problem arises from a simple mistake.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题源于一个简单的错误。
words.en: If a situation or problem arises from a particular event or activity, it is caused by it.

words.tr: phrase. 艺术展览；美术展览
words.ex: They visited an art exhibition last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们上周末参观了一个艺术展览。
words.en: An art exhibition is a public display of works of art, often in a museum or gallery, where people can view and appreciate the artwork.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了一个美术馆。
words.en: A place where works of art are displayed for public viewing.

words.ex: He didn't study hard, as a result, he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他没有努力学习，结果考试不及格。
words.en: used to introduce the consequence or effect of a particular situation or event

words.tr: phrase. 由于…的结果；起因；经；因
words.ex: He was late as a result of the bus breaking down.
words.ex_cn: 由于公交车坏了，他迟到了。
words.en: Because of something that has happened.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.tr: phrase. 远到；至于；直到；就…而言
words.ex: The river flows as far as the next town.
words.ex_cn: 这条河一直流到下一个城镇。
words.en: used to indicate the extent or degree of something

words.ex: As far as I know, he lives in New York.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，他住在纽约。
words.en: According to the information that I have.

words.w: as far as sth. is concerned
words.uk: æz fɑː æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz kənˈsɜːnd
words.us: æz fɑːr æz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz kənˈsɜːrnd
words.ex: As far as math is concerned, he is very good.
words.ex_cn: 就数学而言，他非常擅长。
words.en: When you are discussing or considering a particular subject.

words.ex: As I see it, we should go home now.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，我们现在应该回家了。
words.en: Used to introduce someone's opinion.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: He eats as much as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他吃得和他兄弟一样多。
words.en: You use 'as much as' to say that something is true to the same extent as something else.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as though he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something seems to be, or how someone behaves, when this is not the real situation

words.ex: He arrived late, as usual.
words.ex_cn: 他像往常一样迟到了。
words.en: As usual means in the same way as what happens most of the time or in most cases.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.tr: phrase. 自找麻烦；自寻烦恼
words.ex: If you drive too fast, you are asking for trouble.
words.ex_cn: 如果你开得太快，就是在自找麻烦。
words.en: To behave in a way that is likely to cause problems or difficulties.

words.ex: Workers stand on the assembly line to put parts together.
words.ex_cn: 工人们站在装配线上组装零件。
words.en: An assembly line is a manufacturing process in which parts are added to a product in a sequential manner to create a finished product.

words.ex: He will assist with the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他将帮忙做作业。
words.en: To help or support someone in completing a task or activity.

words.tr: phrase. 困惑；不知所措；亏本地
words.ex: He was at a loss when the teacher asked him a question.
words.ex_cn: 当老师问他问题时，他不知所措。
words.en: If you say that you are at a loss, you mean that you do not know what to do in a particular situation.

words.ex: He fixed the car at a significant cost.
words.ex_cn: 他修车花了一大笔钱。
words.en: When something is achieved at a significant cost, it means that it is accomplished but at a great expense or sacrifice.

words.tr: phrase. 一直；随时；每时每刻
words.ex: He wears a helmet at all times when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他骑自行车时一直戴着头盔。
words.en: If something happens or is done at all times, it happens or is done all the time or always.

words.ex: You can call me at any time.
words.ex_cn: 你随时都可以给我打电话。
words.en: At any time means whenever it is needed or desired; it does not matter when.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.tr: phrase. 听候某人吩咐；乐意帮助某人
words.ex: I am at your service if you need help.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，我随时为你效劳。
words.en: Ready to help or be used by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 处境危险；遭受危险
words.ex: The children are at risk without proper care.
words.ex_cn: 这些孩子如果没有适当的照顾就会有危险。
words.en: In a situation where there is a possibility of something bad happening.

words.ex: At some stage, he will understand the truth.
words.ex_cn: 在某个时候，他会明白真相。
words.en: At some stage refers to a point in time or a phase in a process that is not specified but is expected to occur.

words.ex: He will call you at the end of the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他会在会议结束时给你打电话。
words.en: Indicates the final part of a period of time, an event, a process, or a physical object.

words.ex: He succeeded at the expense of his health.
words.ex_cn: 他成功了，但牺牲了自己的健康。
words.en: If something is done at the expense of someone or something else, it is done in a way that harms them or is unfair to them.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.tr: phrase. 在开头时；从一开始
words.ex: At the outset, he said he would help.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他说他会帮忙。
words.en: At the beginning of something.

words.ex: The flag is at the top of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在山顶上。
words.en: At the highest part or point of something.

words.ex: At this stage, he is learning to read.
words.ex_cn: 在这个阶段，他正在学习阅读。
words.en: At a particular point or step in a process or series of events.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.tr: phrase. 附上；连接；认为有（重要性或意义）
words.ex: Please attach the file to the email before sending.
words.ex_cn: 发送前请将文件附加到邮件上。
words.en: To fasten or join something to something else.

words.ex: He attempted to climb the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 他试图爬这座山。
words.en: To try to do something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: His attitude towards homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对待作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: A person's feelings, opinions, or way of thinking about something.

words.tr: phrase. 平均工资；中等收入
words.ex: The average salary in this city is $3,000 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的平均工资是每月3000美元。
words.en: The mean amount of money earned per worker in a certain area or industry.

words.ex: The baby sleeps in a baby cot.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿睡在婴儿床里。
words.en: A baby cot is a small bed specifically designed for infants and very young children, typically with high sides to prevent the child from falling out.

words.ex: He is waiting at the baggage reclaim after the flight.
words.ex_cn: 他在航班后等待提取行李。
words.en: The area in an airport where passengers collect their luggage after a flight.

words.tr: phrase. 保释；舀出；跳伞；摆脱困境
words.ex: His friend paid money to bail him out of jail.
words.ex_cn: 他的朋友付钱把他从监狱里保释出来。
words.en: To bail out means to remove water from a boat using a bucket, or to help a person or organization out of a difficult situation, especially financial trouble.

words.ex: He checked his bank statement last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚查看了他的银行对账单。
words.en: A bank statement is a document that shows all the transactions that have occurred in a bank account over a specific period of time, usually a month.

words.tr: phrase. 银行间的转帐； 银行汇款
words.ex: He made a bank transfer to pay his rent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过银行转账支付了房租。
words.en: A bank transfer is a method of transferring money from one bank account to another.

words.ex: The bar graph shows the number of students in each class.
words.ex_cn: 这个矩形图显示了每个班级的学生人数。
words.en: A bar graph is a chart that uses bars to show comparisons among categories. The bars can be either horizontal or vertical.

words.ex: The sun burns bare skin quickly.
words.ex_cn: 阳光很快晒伤裸露的皮肤。
words.en: The skin that is not covered by any clothing or protection.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没去上学。
words.en: If someone is absent from a place where they are usually found or where they are expected to be, they are not there.

words.ex: The song is accompanied by a guitar.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌由吉他伴奏。
words.en: To be accompanied by someone or something means to have them with you as a companion, escort, or accompaniment.

words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.ex: He is against eating meat.
words.ex_cn: 他反对吃肉。
words.en: To oppose or disagree with something.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.tr: phrase. 即将来临；在转角处
words.ex: The holiday is around the corner.
words.ex_cn: 假期就要到了。
words.en: If you say that something is around the corner, you mean that it will happen very soon.

words.tr: phrase. 和…联系在一起；与…有关
words.ex: He is associated with the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他与当地医院有关联。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected because they happen together or one thing causes the other.

words.ex: He is attached to his old phone.
words.ex_cn: 他依恋他的旧手机。
words.en: To be connected or joined to something, either physically or emotionally.

words.ex: The success of the project can be attributed to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的成功归功于努力工作。
words.en: If something is attributed to an event or situation, it is said to be caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 以…为基础；以…为根据
words.ex: The plan is based on simple rules.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是基于简单规则的。
words.en: If something is based on something else, it uses it as the thing from which it develops.

words.ex: Eating vegetables is beneficial to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。
words.en: To be beneficial to something means to have a good effect or influence on it.

words.tr: phrase. 最好与……搭配；最适合与……一起
words.ex: This wine is best with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 这种酒最好与奶酪搭配。
words.en: To work or function most effectively in combination with something else.

words.tr:
n. 责任；责备；
v. 责怪；归咎于；
words.ex: He took the blame for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: The ship is bound for Japan.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船开往日本。
words.en: To be destined or heading towards a particular place or goal.

words.ex: He is tired, so he is bound to fall asleep soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很累，所以很快就会睡着。
words.en: Certain or destined to happen; inevitably going to occur.

words.tr: phrase. 无法修复的；损坏至无法挽回的程度
words.ex: The old phone is broken beyond repair.
words.ex_cn: 这部旧手机坏得无法修复了。
words.en: Something that is broken beyond repair cannot be fixed or mended.

words.ex_cn: 学校离公园很近。
words.en: To be near in space, time, or relationship.

words.ex: His health is closely linked to his diet.
words.ex_cn: 他的健康与他的饮食密切相关。
words.en: To be closely connected or associated with something.

words.ex: The team is composed of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: If something is composed of particular things, people, or elements, it is made from those things, people, or elements.

words.ex: She is concerned about her son's health.
words.ex_cn: 她担心她儿子的健康。
words.en: To be worried or anxious about something or someone.

words.ex_cn: 他关心他的成绩。
words.en: If you are concerned with something, you are giving it your attention because you think it is important or because you are worried about it.

words.ex: He is confronted with a difficult problem.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个困难的问题。
words.en: To be faced with or opposed by something or someone, typically in a challenging or hostile manner.

words.tr: adj. 迷惑的；混乱的； v. 迷惑；混淆；“confuse”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He looked confused when the teacher asked the question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他看起来很迷惑。
words.en: If you are confused, you do not know exactly what is happening or what to do.

words.ex: The ground is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 地面被雪覆盖。
words.en: To have something spread over or upon a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 着迷的；狂热的；热衷于
words.ex: He is crazy about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他酷爱打篮球。
words.en: To be extremely enthusiastic or passionate about something.

words.ex: He is dependent on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母给钱生活。
words.en: rely on something or someone for support or existence

words.tr: phrase. 依赖于……的；取决于……的
words.ex: The plant is dependent upon sunlight to grow.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物依赖阳光生长。
words.en: Reliant on or determined by something else.

words.ex: The sky is dotted with stars.
words.ex_cn: 天空布满了星星。
words.en: To be scattered or sprinkled with something, typically in a way that creates a pattern or design.

words.tr: phrase. 有资格的；符合某事的条件
words.ex: He is eligible for a scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格获得奖学金。
words.en: To have the right to do or obtain something through satisfying the appropriate conditions.

words.tr: phrase. 被压印有...字样或图案
words.ex: The card is embossed with her name.
words.ex_cn: 这张卡上印有她的名字。
words.en: To have a design or pattern raised above the surface of something as a form of decoration.

words.ex: He is entitled to free healthcare.
words.ex_cn: 他有权享受免费医疗。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.ex: He is entitled to speak at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他有权在会议上发言。
words.en: If you are entitled to do something, you have the right to do it or to have it.

words.ex: The lab is equipped with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 实验室配备了新的电脑。
words.en: To be provided with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 被从...赶走；被从...开除
words.ex: He was expelled from school for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反校规被学校开除了。
words.en: To be officially forced to leave a place, organization, or school because of bad behavior or breaking rules.

words.ex: He is familiar with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are familiar with something, you know or understand it well.

words.ex: He is fascinated by stars.
words.ex_cn: 他被星星深深吸引。
words.en: To be extremely interested in something, so that you want to look at it, learn about it etc.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.ex: He is fussy about his food.
words.ex_cn: 他对食物很挑剔。
words.en: To be very particular or difficult to please about something.

words.ex: Pandas are going extinct because of habitat loss.
words.ex_cn: 由于栖息地丧失，熊猫正面临灭绝。
words.en: To be in the process of becoming extinct, especially of a species or group of organisms.

words.ex_cn: 他擅长数字。
words.en: To be skilled or proficient at handling or using something.

words.tr: phrase. 对...坦诚；对...说老实话
words.ex: Be honest with your teacher about the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 对你老师坦白这个错误。
words.en: To tell the truth or not hide anything from someone.

words.tr: phrase. 对于…是理想的；对...是最合适
words.ex: This tool is ideal for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具非常适合初学者。
words.en: If something is ideal for a particular purpose, it is perfect for that purpose.

words.ex: He is impatient with slow students.
words.ex_cn: 他对反应慢的学生没有耐心。
words.en: To feel or show a lack of patience towards someone or something.

words.ex: He is in charge of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他负责这个教室。
words.en: To have control over or responsibility for something.

words.ex: He is in good form before the match.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛前状态很好。
words.en: To be performing well or at one's best, especially in a physical or competitive context.

words.ex: He runs every day to be in good shape.
words.ex_cn: 他每天跑步以保持良好的体形。
words.en: To be in a good physical condition or to be well-prepared for something.

words.ex: He is in good health after the vacation.
words.ex_cn: 度假后，他身体很好。
words.en: To be in good health means to be physically well and free from illness.

words.tr: phrase. 因...丧失能力；因...不能自理
words.ex: He was incapacitated with pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故后，他因疼痛而无法行动。
words.en: To be unable to function or act normally due to an illness or injury.

words.tr: adj. 不兼容的；不相配的；
words.ex: The software is incompatible with old systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.ex: He is innovative with using old bottles to make lamps.
words.ex_cn: 他用旧瓶子做灯，很有创意。
words.en: To create or use new ideas or methods for something.

words.tr: phrase. 热衷于；喜爱；对…极感兴趣
words.ex: He is keen on playing football.
words.ex_cn: 他非常热衷于踢足球。
words.en: If you are keen on something, you like it a lot and are very enthusiastic about it.

words.ex: He is likely to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.

words.ex: The school is located on Main Street.
words.ex_cn: 学校位于主街上。
words.en: To be situated in a particular place.

words.ex: He is mad about football.
words.ex_cn: 他非常热爱足球。
words.en: To be extremely enthusiastic or passionate about something.

words.ex: He is mad at his brother for breaking his toy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为弟弟弄坏了玩具而生他的气。
words.en: To feel or show anger towards someone.

words.ex: The wood can be made into tables.
words.ex_cn: 木头可以被做成桌子。
words.en: To be transformed or converted into a different form or product.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.ex: Good teachers motivate students to learn.
words.ex_cn: 好老师激励学生学习。
words.en: To motivate someone means to provide them with a reason for doing something, especially something that requires effort.

words.tr: adj. 紧张不安的；神经系统的；
words.ex: He felt nervous before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到紧张不安。
words.en: If someone is nervous, they are frightened or worried about something that is happening or might happen, and show this in their behavior.

words.tr: phrase. 关系好；只是泛泛之交
words.ex: They are on speaking terms after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵之后，他们恢复了联系。
words.en: To have a relationship with someone where you are willing to talk to each other, especially after a disagreement or argument.

words.tr: phrase. 万无一失；为求保险
words.ex_cn: 我会带把伞，以确保安全。
words.en: To take extra precautions to ensure safety or to avoid risk.

words.tr: phrase. 开放；易受到；易遭受
words.ex_cn: 他愿意接受新想法。
words.en: To be willing to consider or accept something.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.tr: phrase. 充满…的；塞满…的；大量包含…的
words.ex: The box is packed with books.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子装满了书。
words.en: If a place or container is packed with things or people, it is full of them.

words.tr:
adj. 平行的；
n. 类似的事物；
words.ex: The two lines are parallel and never meet.
words.ex_cn: 这两条线是平行的，永远不会相交。
words.en: Something that is parallel to something else is similar to it in many ways, or happens at the same time as it.

words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: To be liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people within a specific group.

words.tr: phrase. 准备做某事；愿意做某事
words.ex: He is prepared to work hard for his exam.
words.ex_cn: 他准备好为考试努力学习。
words.en: If you are prepared to do something, you are willing to do it if necessary.

words.ex: He is prone to making small mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他容易犯小错误。
words.en: If someone is prone to something, they are likely to do it or experience it.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.ex: This topic is relevant to our project.
words.ex_cn: 这个话题与我们的项目相关。
words.en: To be connected with what is happening or being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 远离的；与…大相径庭的；脱离…的
words.ex: He was removed from the city to live in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他被远离城市，搬到乡下生活。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or position.

words.tr: v. 代替；取代；“replace”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old phone was replaced by a new one.
words.ex_cn: 旧手机被新手机代替了。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: To have the duty of taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.ex: He is satisfied with his test score.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的考试成绩感到满意。
words.en: To feel content or pleased with something because it meets your expectations or desires.

words.ex: He was shocked to see the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 他看到破碎的窗户时感到震惊。
words.en: To be very surprised or upset by something that happens or by something that someone does.

words.ex: He was shouted at for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他因为迟到而被大喊大叫。
words.en: To be the recipient of someone's loud vocal expression, often in anger or to gain attention.

words.ex: He is sick with a cold.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了。
words.en: If you are sick with a particular illness, you have that illness. If you are sick with a particular emotion, you feel that emotion very strongly.

words.ex_cn: 他卡在这个数学题上了。
words.en: To be unable to move or to be fixed in a particular position, or to be very interested in or fond of someone or something.

words.ex: He is suited to teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他适合教孩子。
words.en: To be appropriate or well-matched for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: He is supposed to do his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他应该在晚饭前做作业。
words.en: If you say that something is supposed to happen, you mean that it is planned or expected to happen, or it has been announced that it will happen.

words.ex: He was taken aback by the sudden news.
words.ex_cn: 他被这个突如其来的消息吓了一跳。
words.en: To be very surprised or shocked by something.

words.ex_cn: 他因为偷钱被送上法庭。
words.en: To be legally charged and required to appear in court.

words.ex: The market is teeming with people on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 周末市场上人山人海。
words.en: If a place is teeming with people, animals, or things, it is full of them and they are all moving about.

words.ex: He is told to do his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都被要求做作业。
words.en: To be instructed or ordered to perform a specific action.

words.tr: phrase. 在……之间左右为难的；难以抉择的
words.ex: He is torn between accepting the job or staying with his family.
words.ex_cn: 他在接受这份工作和留在家人身边之间左右为难。
words.en: If you are torn between two or more things, you cannot decide which to choose, because you find them all equally attractive or important.

words.ex: This math problem is unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个数学问题对他来说不熟悉。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.tr: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的；
words.ex: He was unwilling to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you are unwilling to do something, you do not want to do it and will not agree to do it.

words.ex: Water is vital to all living things.
words.ex_cn: 水对所有生物都至关重要。
words.en: To be extremely important or necessary for the success, existence, or health of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 生活富裕 ；处境良好
words.ex: They are well off because they have a big house and a car.
words.ex_cn: 他们很富裕，因为他们有一栋大房子和一辆车。
words.en: To be in a comfortable financial situation; to have enough money to live well.

words.ex: She goes to the beauty salon every week.
words.ex_cn: 她每周都去美容院。
words.en: A beauty salon is a place where people can go to receive beauty treatments, such as haircuts, manicures, and facials.

words.tr: phrase. 床上用品；被单和枕套
words.ex: She bought new bed linen for her bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 她为卧室买了新的床单被套。
words.en: Sheets, pillowcases, and other items used on a bed.

words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: If something belongs to you, you own it or it is yours.

words.ex: He bend over to pick up the pen.
words.ex_cn: 他弯下腰去捡笔。
words.en: To bend over means to bend your body forwards and downwards.

words.ex: He benefits from eating healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他从吃健康食品中获益。
words.en: To gain an advantage or profit from something.

words.tr: phrase. 买得最合算的商品
words.ex: This store has the best buy for headphones.
words.ex_cn: 这家店的耳机买得最合算。
words.en: The best buy refers to the most advantageous purchase or deal available, offering the highest value for the money spent.

words.ex: He is the best man at his friend's wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他是他朋友婚礼上的伴郎。
words.en: The best man is the chief male attendant of the bridegroom at a wedding.

words.ex: Beware of the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当心那只狗。
words.en: to be cautious and alert to the dangers of.

words.tr: phrase. 投标；许诺以获支持；追求
words.ex: He will bid for the contract next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会竞标这个合同。
words.en: To offer a particular amount of money for something, especially at an auction, or to try to achieve something, such as a contract or position.

words.ex: They blame him for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他们因这个错误责备他。
words.en: If you blame a person or thing for something bad, you believe or say that they are responsible for it or that they caused it.

words.ex: He checks his blood pressure every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上测量血压。
words.en: The force that blood exerts against the walls of the blood vessels, especially the arteries, as it is pumped around the body by the heart.

words.tr: phrase. 使充气；爆炸；发怒；夸大
words.ex: He blew up the balloon with his mouth.
words.ex_cn: 他用嘴把气球吹鼓了。
words.en: If someone blows something up or if it blows up, it is destroyed by an explosion.

words.ex: He lives in a boarding school far from home.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离家很远的寄宿学校。
words.en: A boarding school is a school where some or all pupils not only study but also live during term time, with their fellow students and possibly teachers.

words.ex: I booked over the phone.
words.ex_cn: 我通过电话预订了。
words.en: To make a reservation or arrange for something to be held or delivered by means of a telephone call.

words.tr: phrase. 登记入住；预约登记
words.ex: I will book in for a hotel room tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要预订一个酒店房间。
words.en: To reserve a place or accommodation, especially in a hotel or for an event.

words.ex: Winning the game boosted his confidence.
words.ex_cn: 赢得比赛增强了他的自信心。
words.en: To increase someone's confidence or self-esteem.

words.ex: This new tool can boost the efficiency of our work.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具可以提高我们工作的效率。
words.en: To increase the effectiveness or productivity of something.

words.ex: He did not bother to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他懒得去接电话。
words.en: To take the trouble to do something.

words.ex: He didn't bother with the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他没有费心做作业。
words.en: To take the trouble to do something; to concern oneself with something.

words.ex: The box office closed at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 售票处在晚上8点关闭。
words.en: The box office refers to the office in a theatre, cinema, or concert hall where tickets are sold, or to the amount of money that a film, play, or actor has earned by selling tickets.

words.ex: He bought a shoe with a famous brand name.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一双有著名品牌的鞋子。
words.en: A brand name is the name given to a product by the company that produces it.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: He runs fast and breaks records.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，打破了纪录。
words.en: To achieve a performance or result that surpasses all previous records.

words.ex: He runs fast and breaks the record.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，打破了纪录。
words.en: To surpass a previously established high score or performance level.

words.tr: phrase. 使表现出；说出；呈出；出版
words.ex: The new lighting really brings out the colors in the painting.
words.ex_cn: 新灯光让画中的颜色更加突出。
words.en: To cause something to be seen or known; to publish something.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: He has a broadband connection at home.
words.ex_cn: 他家有宽带连接。
words.en: A broadband connection is a high-speed internet connection that is always on and faster than the traditional dial-up access.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 复习；温习；提高（技能）
words.ex: I will brush up on my English before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 我将在考试前复习一下英语。
words.en: To improve your knowledge of something already learned but partly forgotten.

words.ex: The budget price range is from $10 to $30.
words.ex_cn: 预算价格范围是10美元到30美元。
words.en: A budget price range refers to a set of prices that are considered affordable for consumers with limited spending capacity, typically encompassing products or services that are priced lower than average to appeal to cost-conscious buyers.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；逐步增长；加强
words.ex: He builds up his strength by running every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天跑步来增强体力。
words.en: To increase or develop something gradually; to accumulate or amass something over time.

words.ex: Practicing every day can help you build up your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 每天练习可以帮助你建立信心。
words.en: To increase someone's belief in their own abilities.

words.ex: He wrote each idea as a bullet point.
words.ex_cn: 他把每个想法写成一个要点。
words.en: A bullet point is one of a series of important items for discussion or action in a document, usually marked by a small square or circle.

words.tr: phrase. 偶然遇见；意外碰到
words.ex: I bump into my friend at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店碰到了我的朋友。
words.en: If you bump into someone you know, you meet them unexpectedly.

words.ex: The candle burned out after five hours.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛燃烧了五个小时后熄灭了。
words.en: If someone burns out, they become exhausted or lose their enthusiasm because they have been working too hard or for too long.

words.ex: The bus route goes past my house.
words.ex_cn: 这条公交路线经过我家。
words.en: A bus route is the path or course that a bus follows regularly, often including a series of stops.

words.tr: phrase. 买下某人的全部产权
words.ex: He bought his partner out and started the business alone.
words.ex_cn: 他买断了合伙人的股份，独自经营生意。
words.en: To purchase someone's share in a business, thereby gaining control over it.

words.ex: He wrote the letter by hand.
words.ex_cn: 他亲手写了这封信。
words.en: If something is done by hand, it is done using someone's hands rather than a machine.

words.ex: He knows the poem by heart.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首诗背得滚瓜烂熟。
words.en: If you know something by heart, you have learned it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: He bought the car by installment.
words.ex_cn: 他分期付款买了这辆车。
words.en: By installment means paying for something in parts over a period of time rather than paying the full amount at once.

words.ex: He cleaned the floor by means of a mop.
words.ex_cn: 他用拖把打扫了地板。
words.en: If you do something by means of a particular method, instrument, or process, you do it using that method, instrument, or process.

words.ex: He is a teacher by profession.
words.ex_cn: 他以教师为职业。
words.en: Used to indicate someone's profession or occupation.

words.ex: By the middle of June, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到六月中旬，他完成了作业。
words.en: Indicates that something happens or is the case at the midpoint of a specified period.

words.tr: phrase. 顺便说说；顺便提起
words.ex: By the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 对了，我昨天看到你弟弟了。
words.en: used to introduce a comment or question that is not directly related to the main subject of conversation

words.ex: The teacher asked the student to call out the answer.
words.ex_cn: 老师让那个学生大声说出答案。
words.en: To shout or speak loudly in order to get someone's attention, or to summon someone to come or to do something.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the call slip.
words.ex_cn: 他在借书单上写了名字。
words.en: A call slip is a form used in libraries to request a book or other material that is kept in closed stacks.

words.ex: He cancel his reservation at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他取消了在餐厅的预订。
words.en: To cancel one's reservation means to decide not to keep a booking or appointment that one has made, often by informing the place where the booking was made.

words.ex: He cancel his reservation at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 他取消了在餐厅的预订。
words.en: To cancel one's reservation means to decide not to keep a booking or appointment that one has made, often by informing the place where the booking was made.

words.ex: The car exhaust fume makes the air dirty.
words.ex_cn: 汽车尾气使空气变脏。
words.en: Exhaust fumes are the gases which are produced when petrol is burned in a car engine.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；坚持；进行；开展
words.ex: He will carry on working after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会继续工作。
words.en: If you carry on, you continue doing something.

words.ex: They will carry out the experiment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将进行这个实验。
words.en: To perform or complete a task, duty, or project.

words.tr: phrase. 个案研究；案例分析；调查研究
words.ex: He did a case study on a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于小企业的案例研究。
words.en: A case study is a detailed examination of a particular case or situation, especially in order to understand its complexities or to test a theory.

words.ex: He went to the bank to cash the check.
words.ex_cn: 他去银行兑现支票。
words.en: To exchange a check for its cash value at a bank or financial institution.

words.ex: He went to the bank to cash the cheque.
words.ex_cn: 他去银行兑现支票。
words.en: To exchange a cheque for its monetary value in cash.

words.ex: He withdrew money from the cashpoint machine.
words.ex_cn: 他从自动取款机取了钱。
words.en: A cashpoint machine is a machine, usually in a wall outside a bank, from which you can take money out of your bank account using a special card.

words.ex: He cast his eyes along the row of trees.
words.ex_cn: 他将目光投向那一排树。
words.en: To look or glance along something.

words.ex: I catch a glimpse of the bird in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 我瞥见了树上的鸟。
words.en: To see someone or something for a very short time.

words.tr: phrase. 当场抓住某人做坏事，尤指正在行窃
words.ex: The police caught the thief red-handed.
words.ex_cn: 警察当场抓住了小偷。
words.en: To catch someone in the act of committing a crime or doing something wrong.

words.ex: The café caters for breakfast and lunch.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆供应早餐和午餐。
words.en: To cater for something means to provide all the things that are needed or wanted for a particular purpose or event.

words.ex: He took a certificate course in English last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天参加了一个英语证书课程。
words.en: A certificate course is a short course of study that results in a certificate rather than a degree.

words.ex: He changed his mind and decided to go to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他改变了主意，决定去参加派对。
words.en: If you change your mind, you make a different decision or have a different opinion from the one you had before.

words.ex: They took a charter flight to the island.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘坐包机去了那个岛屿。
words.en: A charter flight is a flight that is not part of an airline's regular schedule, but is specially arranged for a particular group of people or for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I need to chase up the delivery driver.
words.ex_cn: 我需要追上送货司机。
words.en: To chase someone up means to remind or urge them to do something they have promised or are supposed to do.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.ex: He checks in at the hotel at 3 PM.
words.ex_cn: 他在下午三点办理入住。
words.en: To announce your arrival, especially at a hotel or an airport, by signing your name or showing your ticket.

words.ex: The manager checks on the workers every hour.
words.ex_cn: 经理每小时监督工人们。
words.en: To verify or ensure the condition or status of something or someone.

words.ex: We checked out of the hotel after paying the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我们付完账后离开了酒店。
words.en: To check out means to leave a hotel after paying your bill, or to examine something or someone in order to be certain that everything is correct, safe, or satisfactory.

words.tr: phrase. 支票账户（主要用于日常存取和支付的银行账户）
words.ex: He uses a checking account to pay his bills.
words.ex_cn: 他用支票账户支付账单。
words.en: A checking account is a bank account from which money can be withdrawn by writing checks or using a debit card.

words.ex: He deposits money into his cheque account.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存入他的支票账户。
words.en: A cheque account is a bank account that allows you to write cheques to pay for goods and services.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.ex: The cheering section waved flags and shouted loudly.
words.ex_cn: 啦啦队挥舞着旗帜，大声喊叫。
words.en: A group of people who cheer for a team or individual during a sporting event or competition.

words.ex: They go to church service every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周日去参加教堂礼拜。
words.en: A church service is a formalized period of communal worship in Christianity, often including prayers, hymns, and a sermon.

words.ex: He works as a civil servant in the city hall.
words.ex_cn: 他在市政厅担任公务员。
words.en: A civil servant is a person who works in the public sector, typically for a government department or agency, in a non-political role.

words.tr: phrase. 古典文学；经典文学
words.ex: He reads classical literature every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读古典文学。
words.en: Literature of the ancient Greeks and Romans, or of any culture or period that is considered to have produced the best and most enduring works.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical music refers to the art music produced or rooted in the traditions of Western culture, including both liturgical (religious) and secular music.

words.tr: phrase. 打扫干净；收拾整洁
words.ex: They clean up the room every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每星期六打扫房间。
words.en: To make a place or thing clean and tidy by removing dirt, rubbish, or unwanted items.

words.tr: phrase. 清除；摆脱；走开；消散
words.ex: Clear off the table before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 晚饭前把桌子收拾干净。
words.en: To leave a place quickly or to remove something completely.

words.ex: The book is in the closed reserve at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆的闭架阅览区。
words.en: A state of being reserved or restrained, often due to shyness or caution.

words.ex: The library has closed stacks, so you cannot enter.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆有闭架书库，所以你不能进入。
words.en: In a library, closed stacks are areas where books and other materials are stored and are not directly accessible to the public. Access to these materials is usually restricted and requires assistance from library staff.

words.tr: phrase. 工作中的休息时间；茶歇
words.ex: We took a coffee break at 10 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们在上午10点休息喝咖啡。
words.en: A short period of rest from work during which people drink coffee or other beverages.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.ex: The movie comes to an end at nine o'clock.
words.ex_cn: 电影在九点结束。
words.en: To reach a point where something stops or finishes.

words.tr: phrase. 完全失败；终成泡影； 化为乌有
words.ex: Their plans for a trip came to nothing because of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他们的旅行计划因为下雨而落空了。
words.en: If something comes to nothing, it fails or does not achieve anything.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.ex: The temperature came up to 30 degrees yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度升到了30度。
words.en: To reach a particular standard or level; to be as good as expected.

words.ex: He ran fast to come up with the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，以便赶上公交车。
words.en: If you come up with a plan, idea, or solution, you think of it and suggest it.

words.ex: This painting has high commercial value.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画具有很高的商业价值。
words.en: Commercial value refers to the worth of a good or service in terms of money. It is the amount that someone is willing to pay for it in the marketplace.

words.ex: He works at a commercial bank in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他在城市的一家商业银行工作。
words.en: A commercial bank is a financial institution that provides services such as accepting deposits, offering business loans, and offering basic investment products.

words.ex: The merchant bank gave a loan to the small business.
words.ex_cn: 商业银行向这家小企业提供了贷款。
words.en: A merchant bank is a bank that deals mostly in (but is not limited to) international finance, long-term loans for companies and underwriting. Merchant banks do not provide regular banking services to the general public.

words.ex: He committed a crime last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚犯下一桩罪行。
words.en: To do something illegal or wrong.

words.ex: He used common sense to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用常识解决了这个问题。
words.en: Common sense is the natural ability to make good judgments and to behave in a practical and sensible way.

words.ex: He communicates with his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和朋友交流。
words.en: To share or exchange information, news, or ideas with someone.

words.ex: He compares his score with his friend's score.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的分数和朋友的分数做比较。
words.en: To examine or look for the difference between two or more things.

words.tr: phrase. 与...相兼容；与…和谐相处
words.ex: This phone is compatible with old chargers.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机与旧充电器兼容。
words.en: Able to exist or work together without conflict.

words.ex: The company will compensate for the damaged items.
words.ex_cn: 公司将赔偿损坏的物品。
words.en: To compensate for something means to do something to reduce or balance the negative effect of something else.

words.ex: He competes with his brother for the best grades.
words.ex_cn: 他和弟弟竞争最好的成绩。
words.en: If one company or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its goods or services rather than those of the other company or country.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 他抱怨那噪音太大。
words.en: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

words.ex: They live in a compound apartment near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一套复合公寓里。
words.en: A residential unit combining two or more separate apartments into one larger space.

words.tr: phrase. 懂电脑；电脑操作技术
words.ex: He is computer literate and can use Excel well.
words.ex_cn: 他懂电脑，能很好地使用Excel。
words.en: Having sufficient knowledge and skill to be able to use computers and related technology efficiently.

words.tr: phrase. 集中于； 专心于
words.ex: He must concentrate on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他必须专心做作业。
words.en: To direct all your attention and effort towards a particular activity, subject, or problem.

words.ex: The company made concessions to avoid a strike.
words.ex_cn: 公司做出了让步以避免罢工。
words.en: If you make a concession to someone, you agree to let them do or have something, especially in order to end an argument or conflict.

words.ex: He confines himself to simple meals every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天只吃简单的饭菜。
words.en: To limit or restrict oneself to a particular activity, subject, or area.

words.ex: He confined himself to reading books during the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 他在假期里只限于读书。
words.en: To limit oneself to doing a particular thing.

words.ex: I call the restaurant to confirm a reservation.
words.ex_cn: 我给餐厅打电话确认预订。
words.en: To confirm a reservation means to verify or establish the certainty of a booking arrangement.

words.ex: The team consists of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名球员组成。
words.en: If something consists of particular things or people, it is made up of them.

words.ex: He wears contact lenses to see clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他戴隐形眼镜来看清东西。
words.en: Contact lenses are small, thin lenses that are placed directly on the surface of the eyes to correct vision, as an alternative to glasses.

words.ex: Contrary to his words, he did not help.
words.ex_cn: 与他的话相反，他并没有帮忙。
words.en: In opposition to what is expected or believed.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: He tried to convince her to stay.
words.ex_cn: 他试图说服她留下。
words.en: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He will cooperate with his team to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他将与团队合作完成这个项目。
words.en: To work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor.

words.ex: He tries to cope with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To deal effectively with something difficult.

words.ex: The company got a corporate loan to expand its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司获得了一笔企业贷款来扩展业务。
words.en: A corporate loan is a loan made to a business rather than an individual, typically for the purpose of expansion, equipment purchase, or working capital.

words.ex: He takes a correspondence course to learn English at home.
words.ex_cn: 他通过函授课程在家学习英语。
words.en: A course of study in which student and tutors communicate by post.

words.w: cost sb. an arm and a leg
words.tr: phrase. 使某人付出昂贵的代价
words.uk: kɒst ˈsʌmbədi æn ɑːm ænd ə leɡ
words.us: kɔːst ˈsʌmbədi æn ɑːrm ænd ə leɡ
words.ex: That new phone cost her an arm and a leg.
words.ex_cn: 那部新手机花了她一大笔钱。
words.en: If something costs an arm and a leg, it is very expensive.

words.tr: phrase. 咳出；勉强说出；被迫付出
words.ex: He coughed up a small piece of food.
words.ex_cn: 他咳出了一小块食物。
words.en: To expel something from the throat or lungs by coughing; to reluctantly give or pay money.

words.ex: He went to the counselling service for help.
words.ex_cn: 他去咨询服务中心寻求帮助。
words.en: A counselling service is a professional service that provides advice and support to people dealing with personal issues or psychological problems.

words.ex: I can count on my brother to help me.
words.ex_cn: 我可以依靠我哥哥帮我。
words.en: If you count on someone or something, you rely on them to support you or help you.

words.ex: Your homework will count towards your final grade.
words.ex_cn: 你的作业会计入你的最终成绩。
words.en: If something counts towards or counts toward an achievement or right, it is included as one of the things that give you the right to it.

words.ex: The school changed the course arrangement for next semester.
words.ex_cn: 学校更改了下学期的课程安排。
words.en: The organization and scheduling of courses within an educational program.

words.ex: The course code is MATH101.
words.ex_cn: 这门课的课程代码是MATH101。
words.en: A unique identifier for a specific educational course, often used in registration systems.

words.ex: Students filled out the course feedback form at the end of class.
words.ex_cn: 学生在课程结束时填写了课程反馈表。
words.en: A form used to collect feedback from students about a course.

words.ex: The park covers an area of 50 square kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园占地50平方公里。
words.en: To extend over a specified area.

words.ex: The price covers the cost of breakfast and Wi-Fi.
words.ex_cn: 这个价格包含了早餐和Wi-Fi的费用。
words.en: To pay for the expenses of something.

words.ex: The government will crack down on illegal activities.
words.ex_cn: 政府将严厉打击非法活动。
words.en: To take strong action to stop or punish someone or something that is considered wrong or illegal.

words.ex: The teacher is using cramming teaching before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试前使用填鸭式教学。
words.en: A teaching method that focuses on memorizing information quickly, often for the purpose of passing exams, without emphasizing understanding or critical thinking.

words.ex: He uses a credit card to buy food.
words.ex_cn: 他用信用卡买食物。
words.en: A credit card is a small plastic card that you use to buy things on credit or to borrow money.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.tr: phrase. 不知不觉地来临；悄悄靠近
words.ex: Time can creep up on you if you're not careful.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不小心，时间会悄悄溜走。
words.en: To approach someone or something stealthily or gradually, often without being noticed.

words.ex: The crime rate in this city is low.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的犯罪率很低。
words.en: The crime rate is the number of crimes that are committed in a particular area during a particular period of time.

words.ex: He ran a cross-country race last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末参加了一次越野赛。
words.en: A race that takes place over a course that is not on a track or road, typically through open country or over rough terrain.

words.ex: He felt culture shock when he moved to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到日本时，他感受到了文化冲击。
words.en: Culture shock is the feeling of disorientation experienced by someone when they are suddenly subjected to an unfamiliar culture, way of life, or set of attitudes.

words.ex: This book is not my cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 这本书不是我的菜。
words.en: If something is your cup of tea, it is the kind of thing that you like or are interested in.

words.ex: He bought dollars at the currency exchange.
words.ex_cn: 他在货币兑换处买了美元。
words.en: The process of exchanging one currency for another, especially at a bank or bureau de change.

words.tr: phrase. 活期存款帐户；活期存折；来往户头
words.ex: He checks his current account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周检查他的活期账户。
words.en: A current account is a type of bank account that allows you to deposit and withdraw money frequently, and often comes with a cheque book and a debit card.

words.tr: phrase. 时事；当前发生的重大事件
words.ex: He reads the newspaper to learn about current affairs.
words.ex_cn: 他读报纸来了解时事。
words.en: Current affairs are events of political or social importance and interest happening in the world at the present time.

words.ex: The school changes the curriculum schedule every semester.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会更改课程表。
words.en: A curriculum schedule is a plan that shows the times at which various subjects are taught in a school or college.

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙完成；匆忙离开
words.ex: He can dash off a quick message before the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 他可以在会议开始前匆匆写个消息。
words.en: To write or draw something quickly or carelessly; to leave quickly.

words.ex: This castle dates back to the 12th century.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡可以追溯到12世纪。
words.en: If something dates back to a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 终止日期；借书期限
words.ex: The date of expiry is tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 到期日期是明天。
words.en: The date on which something, especially a contract, agreement, or product, is no longer valid or usable.

words.ex: Call me at my daytime phone number if you need help.
words.ex_cn: 如果你需要帮助，白天给我打电话。
words.en: A telephone number where someone can be reached during the day, typically for business or personal matters.

words.ex: This math problem is dead easy.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题太简单了。
words.en: If you say that something is dead easy, you are emphasizing that it is very easy to do.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: The death toll from the storm is 50.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴的死亡人数是50人。
words.en: The total number of deaths caused by a particular event or over a period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 就……与……进行辩论；与某人就某事展开讨论
words.ex: They debate on climate change with scientists.
words.ex_cn: 他们就气候变化与科学家进行辩论。
words.en: A formal discussion or argument on a specific topic with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 百货商店；百货公司
words.ex: She bought a dress at the department store.
words.ex_cn: 她在百货商店买了一条裙子。
words.en: A large shop divided into several different areas, each of which sells different types of goods.

words.ex: The departmental library has many books for students.
words.ex_cn: 系图书馆有很多学生用的书。
words.en: A library that is associated with a specific department within an institution, offering specialized resources and materials relevant to that department's field of study.

words.ex: He is waiting in the departure lounge.
words.ex_cn: 他正在候机厅等待。
words.en: A departure lounge is a waiting room in an airport or railway station where passengers wait before boarding their transport.

words.ex: He depends on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠他哥哥帮忙。
words.en: To rely on someone or something for support, help, or supply; to be determined or influenced by something.

words.tr: phrase. 定期存款账户；储蓄存款账户
words.ex: He put his savings into a deposit account.
words.ex_cn: 他把积蓄存入了一个定期存款账户。
words.en: A deposit account is a bank account that earns interest and allows you to deposit and withdraw money, but typically does not come with a checkbook or debit card.

words.ex: He deposits money in a bank every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都在银行存钱。
words.en: To place funds into a financial institution for safekeeping and potential interest.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于...； 由...传下来
words.ex: This village descends from a small fishing town.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄起源于一个小型渔村。
words.en: To have a particular person or group as your ancestors.

words.tr: phrase. 彻底失败；完全消失
words.ex: The old machine finally died a death after 20 years.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧机器在使用20年后终于彻底报废了。
words.en: If something dies a death, it fails completely or ends in a very unsuccessful way.

words.ex: Many old traditions die out over time.
words.ex_cn: 许多古老的传统随着时间推移而消失。
words.en: If something dies out, it becomes less and less common and eventually disappears completely.

words.tr: phrase. 浏览；动用（花费）；伸进
words.ex: I dipped into the book to find a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 我翻了翻这本书，想找一个有趣的故事。
words.en: To dip into something means to read or look at parts of it in a casual way, or to use some of a supply of money.

words.ex: He joined a diploma course in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个计算机科学的文凭课程。
words.en: A diploma course is a program of study that leads to a diploma, typically offered by educational institutions as a shorter or more specialized alternative to degree programs.

words.ex: Call the direct line number for quick help.
words.ex_cn: 拨打直拨号码以快速获得帮助。
words.en: A direct line number is a telephone number that connects directly to a specific extension or department without going through a switchboard.

words.ex: We took a direct flight to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘坐了直飞巴黎的航班。
words.en: A flight that goes from one place to another without any stops.

words.ex: He took a non-stop flight to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐了一趟直达纽约的航班。
words.en: A non-stop flight is a flight that travels directly from one place to another without any stops.

words.ex: The students meet in a discussion group every week.
words.ex_cn: 学生们每周都参加一个讨论小组。
words.en: A discussion group is a group of people who meet to discuss a particular topic or issue.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: He takes distance education classes from home.
words.ex_cn: 他从家里上远程教育课程。
words.en: A form of education in which the main elements include physical separation of teachers and students during instruction and the use of various technologies to facilitate student-teacher and student-student communication.

words.ex: We divide the cake into six pieces.
words.ex_cn: 我们把蛋糕分成六块。
words.en: To separate or split something into parts or groups.

words.ex: They divide up the food equally among the children.
words.ex_cn: 他们把食物平均分给孩子们。
words.en: To divide something up means to separate it into different parts or areas, usually so that different people can have or use different parts.

words.ex: The divorce rate has increased in the last ten years.
words.ex_cn: 过去十年里，离婚率有所上升。
words.en: The number of divorces per thousand of the population in a given year.

words.tr: phrase. 面对面的面试；当面访谈
words.ex: I have a face-to-face interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天有一个面对面的面试。
words.en: A face-to-face interview is a meeting in which someone is asked questions to see if they are suitable for a job or course.

words.ex: He will do a presentation on weather changes.
words.ex_cn: 他将做一个关于天气变化的演示。
words.en: To prepare and deliver a formal talk or display of information on a subject.

words.ex: He did background reading before writing the report.
words.ex_cn: 他在写报告之前做了背景阅读。
words.en: To research and study a topic thoroughly before engaging with it in depth.

words.ex: He wants to do further study in physics.
words.ex_cn: 他想进一步学习物理。
words.en: To engage in additional research or learning on a particular subject.

words.ex: She does housework every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六都做家务。
words.en: To perform tasks related to the maintenance and cleaning of a home.

words.tr: n. 慢跑； v. “jog”的现在分词；
words.ex: He goes jogging every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去慢跑。
words.en: Jogging is the activity of running at a slow, regular speed, especially as a form of exercise.

words.tr: 短语动词. 帮某人一个忙
words.ex: Can you do me a favor and open the window?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我个忙打开窗户吗？
words.en: To do something helpful for someone.

words.tr: phrase. 去旅行；出行（常指短途或多次旅行）
words.ex: They take trips to the beach every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们每年夏天去海边旅行。
words.en: To go on a journey or excursion, especially for pleasure.

words.ex: He did his homework on his own.
words.ex_cn: 他独自完成了作业。
words.en: To complete something independently, without help from others.

words.ex: The company sells products in the domestic market.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司在国内市场销售产品。
words.en: The domestic market refers to the supply and demand of goods, services, and securities within a country's borders.

words.ex: He uses a double lock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他给门上了双重锁。
words.en: To lock something with two locks or to lock something in two different ways.

words.ex: The music class is a double unit this week.
words.ex_cn: 这周音乐课是双课时量。
words.en: A double unit refers to something that consists of two parts or elements, often used to describe a type of accommodation or a device that has two separate components.

words.ex: We booked a double-bed room for our trip.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行预订了一间双人床房间。
words.en: A room with a bed designed for two people to sleep in.

words.ex: He will draft an outline for his essay tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将为他的文章草拟一个提纲。
words.en: To create a preliminary framework or plan for a document, project, or speech.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the game because he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他因为累了决定不参与比赛。
words.en: To leave a school, college, or course of study before you have finished it.

words.ex: The drop-out rate in this school is high.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的辍学率很高。
words.en: The percentage of students who leave school or a course of study before completing it.

words.ex: The river may dry up in the summer.
words.ex_cn: 这条河在夏天可能会干涸。
words.en: If something dries up or if something dries it up, it loses all its moisture and becomes completely dry.

words.ex: He was late due to traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: If an event is due to something, it happens or exists as a direct result of that thing.

words.ex: He bought chocolate in a duty-free shop at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场的免税店买了巧克力。
words.en: A duty-free shop is a retail outlet whose goods are exempt from the payment of certain local or national taxes and duties, provided the goods are sold to travelers who will take them out of the country.

words.ex: He is eager to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他急切地想做作业。
words.en: If you are eager to do something, you want to do it very much.

words.tr: phrase. 在外吃饭；上馆子吃饭
words.ex: They eat out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们在周末外出吃饭。
words.en: To have a meal at a restaurant rather than at home.

words.ex: The forest keeps the ecological balance.
words.ex_cn: 森林维持着生态平衡。
words.en: Ecological balance refers to the state of equilibrium within a community of organisms in which genetic, species, and ecosystem diversity remain relatively stable, subject to gradual changes through natural succession.

words.tr: phrase. 教育系统；教育体制
words.ex: The education system in this country is very strict.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的教育制度非常严格。
words.en: The structured framework within which educational activities are organized and conducted, including the policies, institutions, and practices that guide teaching and learning.

words.ex: You can either walk to school or take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 你可以走路去学校，或者坐公交车。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) given alternatives (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr: phrase. 电子小玩意儿；电子产品
words.ex: He uses an electronic gadget to check the time.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个电子小工具来查看时间。
words.en: An electronic gadget is a small device or machine that has a particular function, often one that you do not think of as a computer, but which has some electronic components.

words.ex: He is eligible to do the job because he has the right skills.
words.ex_cn: 他有资格做这份工作，因为他有正确的技能。
words.en: Having the necessary qualities or qualifications to perform a task or action.

words.ex: He will embark on a new journey next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将开始一段新的旅程。
words.en: To start or begin something, especially something new, challenging, or exciting.

words.ex: He will embark upon a new job next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将开始一份新工作。
words.en: To start or engage in a new project or course of action, especially one that is important or challenging.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: The school enjoys a superb reputation for teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校因英语教学而享有极好的声誉。
words.en: To be widely recognized and respected for being excellent or of high quality.

words.ex: I will enquire about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 我会查询一下火车时刻表。
words.en: To ask for information about someone or something.

words.ex: He will enroll in the English course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将注册英语课程。
words.en: To officially register or enlist oneself or someone else in a course, institution, or organization.

words.ex: He paid the enrollment fee to join the class.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了注册费以加入课程。
words.en: A fee charged for registering or enrolling in a course, program, or institution.

words.ex: He filled out the enrollment form yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天填了报名表。
words.en: A document used to register or sign up for something, such as a course, program, or event.

words.ex: The hotel has good entertainment facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有很好的娱乐设施。
words.en: Facilities or amenities designed to provide entertainment and leisure activities to people.

words.ex: He works in the entertainment industry.
words.ex_cn: 他在娱乐行业工作。
words.en: The sector of the economy that provides entertainment, including movies, music, television, and live performances.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: People from every walk of life came to the festival.
words.ex_cn: 来自各行各业的人都来参加了这个节日。
words.en: People from all types of jobs and social positions.

words.ex: The small company evolved into a big business.
words.ex_cn: 这家小公司发展成了大企业。
words.en: To develop gradually, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 超重费用；剩余电荷
words.ex: He paid an excess charge for extra luggage.
words.ex_cn: 他为额外的行李支付了超重费用。
words.en: An extra amount of money that you have to pay, especially when it is more than you expected.

words.ex: The exchange rate is high today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的汇率很高。
words.en: The exchange rate is the rate at which one currency will be exchanged for another. It is also regarded as the value of one country's currency in relation to another currency.

words.ex: He is an exchange student from Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名来自日本的交换生。
words.en: A student who goes to a foreign country to live and study for a period of time, often as part of an organized program.

words.tr: phrase. 开阔某人的眼界；拓展某人的知识面
words.ex: He reads books to expand his knowledge.
words.ex_cn: 他读书以扩展自己的知识。
words.en: To increase the range of one's understanding or information.

words.ex: I expect you to be on time for class.
words.ex_cn: 我期望你上课准时。
words.en: To believe that someone or something will do something in the future.

words.ex: He does extensive reading every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上进行大量阅读。
words.en: Extensive reading refers to reading in quantity and in variety, focusing on the general understanding of texts rather than detailed analysis.

words.tr: phrase. 额外费用；额外成本
words.ex: The extra cost was five dollars.
words.ex_cn: 额外费用是五美元。
words.en: An additional amount of money that is required to be paid beyond the basic price or rate.

words.ex: He made eye contact with the teacher during the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时与老师进行了眼神交流。
words.en: The act of looking directly into someone's eyes as a means of communication or to express interest.

words.ex: He must face up to his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的错误。
words.en: If you face up to a difficult situation, you accept it and deal with it honestly and bravely.

words.ex: The faculty head gave a speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 系主任在会议上发表了演讲。
words.en: The faculty head is the person in charge of a specific department within a university or college, responsible for overseeing the academic and administrative functions of the department.

words.ex: He falls in love with her when he sees her smile.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到她的微笑时，他就爱上了她。
words.en: To begin to feel romantic love for someone.

words.ex: The temperature fell to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零度。
words.en: If someone falls to doing something, they start doing it.

words.ex: The robbers fell upon the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: To happen to someone or something, especially something unpleasant, or to attack someone or something suddenly.

words.ex: The robbers fell on the old man at night.
words.ex_cn: 抢劫者在夜里袭击了那位老人。
words.en: If a duty, responsibility, or opportunity falls on someone, it is their duty, responsibility, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: He tried to familiarize himself with the new software.
words.ex_cn: 他试图熟悉新软件。
words.en: To make oneself knowledgeable or conversant with something.

words.ex: We look at the family album on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期天看家庭相册。
words.en: A family album is a book in which photographs of a family's members and events are kept.

words.ex: Family bonds help people feel safe and loved.
words.ex_cn: 家庭纽带让人感到安全和被爱。
words.en: The emotional connections and relationships within a family that unite its members.

words.ex: The government introduced a family planning policy in 1980.
words.ex_cn: 政府在1980年实施了计划生育政策。
words.en: A government policy aimed at controlling the population growth by regulating the number of children families can have.

words.ex: We had a family reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期天举行了家庭聚会。
words.en: A family reunion is a gathering of family members, often extended family, who come together to celebrate their familial bonds, share memories, and enjoy each other's company. These events are typically organized on a regular basis, such as annually, and can take place in various locations, including family homes, parks, or rented venues.

words.tr: phrase. 对...感到厌烦；对...感到无聊
words.ex: He feels bored with doing the same thing every day.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得每天做同样的事情很无聊。
words.en: To experience a lack of interest or excitement in something.

words.ex: Feel free to ask me any question.
