words.ex_cn: 随意问我任何问题。
words.en: To be encouraged or welcome to do something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 现场调查研究；田野调查
words.ex: He did field research in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他在丛林中进行了实地研究。
words.en: Field research refers to the collection of raw data outside a laboratory, library, or workplace setting. The approaches and methods used in field research vary across disciplines but generally involve direct observation, interviews, and participation in the activities of the community being studied.

words.ex: We went on a field trip to the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园进行了实地考察。
words.en: An excursion or journey made by a group of people, especially students, for the purpose of learning or research outside the classroom.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.

words.tr: phrase. v. 临时接替（某人的工作）；代班；在……方面临时顶替
words.ex: Tom will fill in on the manager's duties while she is away.
words.ex_cn: 当经理离开时，汤姆会临时接替她的工作。
words.en: To provide someone with the latest information about something.

words.ex: He got financial assistance from his parents.
words.ex_cn: 他从父母那里获得了经济援助。
words.en: Financial assistance refers to monetary support provided to individuals, organizations, or governments to help them with their financial needs.

words.ex: He plans his financial budget every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月都规划他的财务预算。
words.en: A financial budget is a detailed plan of the financial resources and expenditures of an organization for a specific period of time, aiming to control costs and allocate resources effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 财务状况；经济情况
words.ex: His financial circumstances changed after he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后，经济状况发生了变化。
words.en: The economic conditions affecting someone's financial situation.

words.ex: The country faced a financial crisis last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家经历了金融危机。
words.en: A financial crisis is a situation in which the value of financial institutions or assets drops rapidly.

words.tr: phrase. 发现做某事有困难；觉得做某事不容易
words.ex: He finds it difficult to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他发现早起很难。
words.en: To experience difficulty in doing something.

words.ex: He will finish off the homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚会完成作业。
words.en: To complete the last part of something; to kill someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 不停地射击；开始说话或做事
words.ex: The soldiers fired away at the enemy during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中不停地向敌人射击。
words.en: If someone tells you to fire away, they are giving you permission to start asking them questions or to start speaking.

words.ex: The fire exit is at the back of the building.
words.ex_cn: 消防出口在大楼的后面。
words.en: A fire exit is a door or other means of escape from a building, especially in the event of a fire.

words.ex: He gave first aid to the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 他给受伤的人进行了急救。
words.en: Immediate assistance given to a person suffering from either a minor or serious illness or injury, with care provided to preserve life, prevent the condition from worsening, or to promote recovery.

words.ex: First of all, we need to clean the room.
words.ex_cn: 首先，我们需要打扫房间。
words.en: Before anything else; initially.

words.tr: phrase. 修理；安排； 为（某人）提供
words.ex: He will fix up his bike tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要修理他的自行车。
words.en: To repair, arrange, or organize something.

words.ex: He tries to flag down a taxi on the busy street.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在繁忙的街道上拦下一辆出租车。
words.en: To signal to a vehicle, especially a taxi or bus, to stop by waving one's hand or an object.

words.ex: He saved the file on a floppy disk.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件保存在软盘上。
words.en: A floppy disk is a small magnetic disk enclosed in a flexible plastic case, used for storing data and transferring it between computers.

words.tr: phrase. 集中（精力；注意力等）于
words.ex: He focuses on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上专心做作业。
words.en: to direct your attention or effort towards something specific

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.ex: The house is for rent.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子出租。
words.en: Available for renting or lease.

words.ex: I don't want to go out for one thing, it is raining.
words.ex_cn: 我不想出去，原因之一是天下雨了。
words.en: used to introduce a reason or argument

words.ex: He studied hard for the sake of his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习是为了家人。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result.

words.tr: phrase. 处于极度兴奋中；崩溃
words.ex: The kids freaked out when they saw the ice cream truck.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们看到冰淇淋车时兴奋得不得了。
words.en: To become or cause to become very excited, anxious, or upset, often suddenly and intensely.

words.ex: The lake will freeze over in winter.
words.ex_cn: 湖水在冬天会结冰。
words.en: If something freezes over, it becomes covered with ice.

words.tr: phrase. 公交车的发车频率
words.ex: The frequency of buses is high during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车的发车频率很高。
words.en: The number of times buses run on a particular route or service.

words.ex: He knew from the outset that it would be hard.
words.ex_cn: 他从一开始就知道这会很难。
words.en: From the very beginning; from the start.

words.tr: phrase. 在开头时；从一开始
words.ex: At the outset, he said he would help.
words.ex_cn: 一开始，他说他会帮忙。
words.en: At the beginning of something.

words.ex: He wrote his full address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 他把完整的地址写在了表格上。
words.en: The complete details of a location, including street name, number, city, and postal code, used for the purpose of identifying a place for delivery or communication.

words.ex: He got a full refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为坏了的手机得到了全额退款。
words.en: A full refund is the return of the entire amount of money paid for a product or service, typically due to dissatisfaction or defect.

words.ex: He is a full-time student at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他是大学里的一名全日制学生。
words.en: A full-time student is someone who is enrolled in a post-secondary institution and is taking a minimum number of credit hours, typically 12 or more, per semester.

words.ex: There are fundamental differences between cats and dogs.
words.ex_cn: 猫和狗之间有根本的区别。
words.en: Basic, essential distinctions that exist between two or more things.

words.tr: phrase. 继续教育；进修；深造
words.ex: He wants to pursue further education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中毕业后继续深造。
words.en: Further education refers to education or training that is taken after secondary school, but not at degree level, often aimed at providing specific skills or qualifications.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…而获得名声、声誉
words.ex: He gains a reputation for being kind and helpful.
words.ex_cn: 他因善良和乐于助人而获得了好名声。
words.en: To become known for a particular quality or achievement.

words.ex: He made a gear change while driving uphill.
words.ex_cn: 他在上坡时换了一挡。
words.en: The act of changing from one gear to another in a vehicle.

words.ex: The gene pool of the island birds is very small.
words.ex_cn: 这些岛屿鸟类的基因库非常小。
words.en: The gene pool is the complete set of unique alleles in a species or population.

words.ex: He visits his general practitioner for a check-up.
words.ex_cn: 他去看全科医生做体检。
words.en: A general practitioner is a doctor who does not specialize in one particular area of medicine, but who has a medical practice in which he or she treats all types of illness.

words.ex: Generally speaking, most students like math.
words.ex_cn: 一般来说，大多数学生喜欢数学。
words.en: Used to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or as a general rule.

words.tr: phrase. 看到...的美景；看清楚…
words.ex: He climbed the hill to get a good view of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他爬上了山，以便好好看看这座城市。
words.en: To obtain a clear and comprehensive sight of something or some place.

words.ex: Get a move on, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点走，不然我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to get a move on, you are telling them to hurry.

words.ex: He got a refund for the broken phone.
words.ex_cn: 他因为那部坏手机拿到了退款。
words.en: Obtain money back for a returned or unsatisfactory purchase.

words.ex: He wants to get admitted to the university.
words.ex_cn: 他想被大学录取。
words.en: To be accepted into a school, program, or institution.

words.ex: I get along with my neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 我和我的邻居相处得很好。
words.en: If you get along with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them.

words.ex: He asked for an extension of time to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他请求延长一点时间来完成作业。
words.en: To obtain additional time to complete a task or deadline.

words.ex: He gets behind with his homework because he watches too much TV.
words.ex_cn: 他因为看了太多电视而落下了作业。
words.en: To fail to keep up with something, such as work or payments, so that you are late or owe money.

words.ex: He gets into the habit of brushing his teeth every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他养成了每天早上刷牙的习惯。
words.en: To start doing something regularly or often, so that it becomes a habit.

words.tr: phrase. 陷入困境；遇到麻烦
words.ex: He gets into trouble when he doesn't listen to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 当他不听老师的话时，他就会陷入麻烦。
words.en: To get into trouble means to become involved in a situation where you are likely to be blamed or punished for something.

words.ex: They got married last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他们去年夏天结婚了。
words.en: To enter into the state of matrimony; to become husband and wife.

words.tr: phrase. 让某人感到烦躁；使某人恼火
words.ex: The loud music next door gets on my nerves.
words.ex_cn: 隔壁的吵闹音乐让我很烦。
words.en: To irritate or annoy someone.

words.ex: I get on with my brother very well.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥相处得很好。
words.en: To continue doing something, especially after an interruption, or to have a good relationship with someone.

words.ex: He got promoted after working hard for two years.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作两年后得到了晋升。
words.en: To be raised to a higher rank or position, especially at work.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.ex: He got separated from his mom at the mall.
words.ex_cn: 他在商场和妈妈走散了。
words.en: To become physically or emotionally detached from someone or something.

words.ex: Let's get straight down to the point: we need more money.
words.ex_cn: 我们开门见山地说：我们需要更多钱。
words.en: To start doing something immediately, without any delay or preamble.

words.ex: He gets stuck in traffic every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都堵车。
words.en: To be unable to move or to be fixed in a particular position or situation.

words.tr: phrase. 得到最划算的交易
words.ex: He tried to get the best deal on a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 他试图买到最划算的新手机。
words.en: To obtain the most advantageous or beneficial agreement or purchase.

words.tr: phrase. 熟悉某物的用法；掌握做某事的窍门
words.ex: He is trying to get the hang of riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他正在努力学会骑自行车。
words.en: If you get the hang of something, you learn how to do it or use it successfully.

words.tr: phrase. 通过；（电话）打通；度过；做完；用完
words.ex: He got through the exam with help from his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在朋友的帮助下通过了考试。
words.en: To succeed in reaching a place or a stage in a process, or to make someone understand or accept something.

words.tr: phrase. 认真处理...；设法对付…；与...扭打
words.ex: He is trying to get to grips with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他正努力掌握基础数学。
words.en: To begin to deal with or understand something seriously.

words.ex: He is getting used to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他正在习惯早起。
words.en: To become familiar with something or someone, so that it/they no longer seem(s) new, strange, or difficult.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.ex: The teacher will give comments on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师会对你的作业给出评论。
words.en: To offer opinions, suggestions, or criticisms about something.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.ex: He gave over the room to storage.
words.ex_cn: 他把房间留作储物用途。
words.en: To dedicate or devote something to a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: The school gives priority to students who need extra help.
words.ex_cn: 学校优先照顾需要额外帮助的学生。
words.en: To treat something as more important than others.

words.ex: The boss gave him a sack for being late every day.
words.ex_cn: 老板因为他每天迟到而解雇了他。
words.en: To dismiss or fire someone from a job.

words.tr: phrase. 对...不予理会；决定不做...；省去...
words.ex: I give the cold food a miss.
words.ex_cn: 我避开那冷的食物。
words.en: If you give something a miss, you decide not to do it or not to go to it.

words.tr: phrase. 赠送；分发；背叛；泄露
words.ex: He will give away his old books to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他将把他的旧书捐给图书馆。
words.en: To give something to someone without asking for payment, or to reveal something secret or private.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: He glance down at his shoes when he feels shy.
words.ex_cn: 他害羞时会低头看他的鞋子。
words.en: To look quickly and briefly at something below one's line of sight.

words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 离开；外出；（症状）消失
words.ex: Go away, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 走开，我需要休息。
words.en: To leave a place or to stop being present in a situation.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会回他的家乡。
words.en: To return to a place or situation that you were in before.

words.ex: The milk will go bad if you leave it out of the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外面，它会变质的。
words.en: If food goes bad, it is no longer fresh or good to eat.

words.ex: We will go for a dinner after the movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们看完电影后去吃晚饭。
words.en: To go out to eat a meal.

words.ex: He will go for an interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要去参加一个面试。
words.en: To attend an interview, typically for a job.

words.ex: He will go for the interview tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要去参加面试。
words.en: To attend a formal meeting for a job or position.

words.ex: Exercise and healthy eating go hand in hand.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼和健康饮食相辅相成。
words.en: If two things go hand in hand, they are closely connected and cannot be considered separately from each other.

words.ex: The firework went off at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 烟花在午夜爆炸了。
words.en: If a device or alarm goes off, it starts to ring loudly or make a loud noise. To leave a place, especially in order to do something. To happen in a particular way. To stop liking someone or something. To explode or fire. To decay or become rotten.

words.ex: They go on a date this Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他们这周五去约会。
words.en: To spend time with someone you are romantically interested in, typically involving an activity such as dining out or watching a movie together.

words.ex: The workers go on strike to ask for higher pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们罢工以要求加薪。
words.en: To stop work as a form of protest, typically in an attempt to gain a particular concession or concessions from their employer.

words.ex: Long skirts go out of fashion last year.
words.ex_cn: 长裙去年过时了。
words.en: If something goes out of fashion, it is no longer popular or fashionable.

words.ex: They go rock climbing on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们周末去攀岩。
words.en: To engage in the sport or activity of climbing rock faces, especially using ropes and special equipment.

words.tr: phrase. 到处走动；流传；供应
words.ex: The children go round the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午到处在公园里走动。
words.en: To move from place to place or to be sufficient for everyone.

words.ex: They go surfing every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末去冲浪。
words.en: To engage in the sport of riding on the crest or along the tunnel of a wave, especially while standing or lying on a surfboard.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 沉没；死；屈服；失败；破产
words.ex: The boat went under after hitting the rock.
words.ex_cn: 船撞上岩石后沉没了。
words.en: To fail, collapse, or be defeated; to sink or submerge.

words.ex: The price of apples will go up next week.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的价格将在下周上涨。
words.en: If a price, amount, or level goes up, it becomes higher or greater than it was.

words.tr: phrase. 伴随；与...相配；同…一致
words.ex: I will go with you to the market.
words.ex_cn: 我会和你一起去市场。
words.en: To be suitable or appropriate with something; to accompany something; to exist or occur together with something.

words.ex: He will graduate from high school next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将从高中毕业。
words.en: To successfully complete a course of study at a school, college, or university and receive a degree or diploma.

words.ex: My brother walked at the graduation ceremony last week.
words.ex_cn: 我哥哥上周参加了毕业典礼。
words.en: A graduation ceremony is an event where students receive their academic degrees or diplomas.

words.tr: phrase. 温室效应气体排放
words.ex: Factories reduce greenhouse gas emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少温室效应气体排放以保护环境。
words.en: The release of gases into the atmosphere that trap heat and contribute to the greenhouse effect, leading to global warming and climate change.

words.ex: The greenhouse effect makes the Earth warmer.
words.ex_cn: 温室效应使地球变暖。
words.en: The greenhouse effect is the process by which radiation from a planet's atmosphere warms the planet's surface to a temperature above what it would be without its atmosphere.

words.ex: The country's gross national product increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 该国的国民生产总值去年增加了。
words.en: The total value of goods produced and services provided by a country during one year, equal to the gross domestic product plus the net income from foreign investments.

words.tr: phrase. 一楼；底层；有利地位
words.ex: The shop is on the ground floor.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在底层。
words.en: The ground floor of a building is the floor that is level or almost level with the ground outside.

words.ex: They had a group discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 他们就作业进行了一次小组讨论。
words.en: A group discussion is a conversation among a group of people on a specific topic, where everyone is encouraged to contribute their ideas and opinions.

words.ex: He will have a group interview next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他下周一将参加小组面试。
words.en: A group interview is a selection process where multiple candidates are interviewed together by one or more interviewers.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.tr: phrase. 有导游的观光旅游
words.ex: We took a guided tour of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了博物馆的导览。
words.en: A guided tour is a tour of a place that is led by a guide who provides information about the place.

words.tr: phrase. 学生宿舍；大学宿舍
words.ex: He lives in the hall of residence near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在图书馆附近的宿舍楼里。
words.en: A hall of residence is a building where students live at a university or college.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: The teacher will hand out the papers now.
words.ex_cn: 老师现在会分发试卷。
words.en: To distribute something to a group of people.

words.ex: He will hand over the keys tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会交出钥匙。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially because you have been ordered to do so or because it is necessary.

words.tr: phrase. 残疾人专用洗手间
words.ex: The handicapped toilet is near the entrance.
words.ex_cn: 无障碍厕所就在入口附近。
words.en: A toilet designed to be accessible to people with disabilities, often featuring additional space, grab bars, and other aids to assist those with mobility impairments.

words.tr: phrase. 不挂断；稍等 ；紧紧抓住
words.ex: Hang on, I will be there soon.
words.ex_cn: 等一下，我马上就到。
words.en: To hold onto something tightly; to wait for a short time.

words.tr: phrase. 紧紧握住；坚持下去；保留
words.ex: He hangs on to his old wallet because it reminds him of his dad.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧保留着旧钱包，因为它让他想起爸爸。
words.en: To keep something that you have, especially because it might be useful or valuable in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 与…出去玩；和…闲逛；与…混在一起
words.ex: I hang out with my friends after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后和朋友一起玩。
words.en: To spend time idly or casually in the company of someone.

words.ex: The dark cloud hangs over the town.
words.ex_cn: 乌云高悬在城镇上空。
words.en: If something such as a problem or threat hangs over you, it worries you or makes you feel that you are in danger.

words.ex: The baby birds will hatch out of the eggs soon.
words.ex_cn: 小鸟很快就会从蛋里孵出来了。
words.en: To hatch out means to emerge from an egg or to develop a plan or idea.

words.ex: They have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月要生孩子。
words.en: To give birth to a child or to become a parent.

words.ex: We have a blast at the park every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末在公园都玩得很开心。
words.en: To have a very enjoyable time.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.ex: He has a fever and stays in bed.
words.ex_cn: 他发烧了，待在床上。
words.en: To suffer from a higher than normal body temperature, often as a symptom of illness.

words.ex: I have a good relationship with my brother.
words.ex_cn: 我和我哥哥关系很好。
words.en: To maintain a positive and constructive interaction or connection with someone.

words.ex: I will have a look around the park.
words.ex_cn: 我会四处看看这个公园。
words.en: To explore or inspect the surrounding area or environment.

words.ex: I have a look at the book.
words.ex_cn: 我看了看这本书。
words.en: To take a brief look at something.

words.tr: phrase. 由于…而获得名声、声誉
words.ex: He has a reputation for being kind.
words.ex_cn: 他以善良著称。
words.en: To be known or famous for something, typically something good.

words.tr: phrase. 对…产生重要的影响
words.ex: Smoking has a significant effect on your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有重大影响。
words.en: To cause a major impact or change on something.

words.ex: Education can have a significant impact on your future.
words.ex_cn: 教育可以对你的未来产生深刻影响。
words.en: To affect something or someone in a major way.

words.ex: I have a sore throat, so I cannot speak loudly.
words.ex_cn: 我喉咙痛，所以不能大声说话。
words.en: To experience pain or discomfort in the throat.

words.ex: I have a stuffed nose because of the cold.
words.ex_cn: 我因为感冒鼻子堵住了。
words.en: To experience nasal congestion, making it difficult to breathe through the nose.

words.tr: phrase. 使用；接近；可以利用
words.ex: Students have access to the library after school.
words.ex_cn: 学生放学后可以使用图书馆。
words.en: To have the right or opportunity to use or see something.

words.ex: He went overdrawn on his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他的银行账户透支了。
words.en: An overdraft occurs when money is withdrawn from a bank account and the available balance goes below zero.

words.ex: There was a disagreement about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 关于这个计划，他们产生了分歧。
words.en: A disagreement is a situation in which people have different opinions about something and often argue.

words.ex: He has taste in coffee and only drinks organic beans.
words.ex_cn: 他对咖啡很讲究，只喝有机咖啡豆。
words.en: To have the ability to judge what is good, attractive, or suitable in a particular area.

words.tr: phrase. 喜欢；对……有兴趣；偏爱
words.ex: He has a taste for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辣的食物。
words.en: If you have a taste for something, you enjoy it or are interested in it.

words.ex: I have faith in you to do the right thing.
words.ex_cn: 我相信你会做正确的事。
words.en: To believe in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something.

words.ex: The two schools have links with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两所学校彼此有联系。
words.en: To be connected or associated with someone or something.

words.w: have no choice but to do
words.tr: phrase. 除…外别无他法；不得不；只好
words.uk: hæv nəʊ tʃɔɪs bət tuː duː
words.us: hæv nəʊ tʃɔɪs bət tuː duː
words.ex: He has no choice but to go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他别无选择，只能去上学。
words.en: To be forced to do something because there is no other option.

words.ex: He has problems with reading English words.
words.ex_cn: 他在读英语单词方面有困难。
words.en: To experience difficulties or issues with something or someone.

words.tr: 已做；已完成（现在完成时结构，表示动作已经完成）
words.ex: I have done my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我已经做完了我的作业。
words.en: To have completed something.

words.ex: He has trouble in reading simple sentences.
words.ex_cn: 他在阅读简单句子方面有困难。
words.en: To experience difficulty in doing something.

words.ex: He has trouble with reading English books.
words.ex_cn: 他在阅读英语书籍方面有困难。
words.en: If you have trouble with something or someone, you have difficulty dealing with them.

words.ex: I don't like spicy food. Having said that, I ate a little today.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢辣的食物。话虽如此，我今天还是吃了一点。
words.en: Despite what has just been said; nevertheless.

words.ex: The health system helps people get medical care.
words.ex_cn: 医疗系统帮助人们获得医疗服务。
words.en: A health system, also sometimes referred to as health care system or healthcare system, is the organization of people, institutions, and resources that deliver health care services to meet the health needs of target populations.

words.ex: He eats a healthy diet every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的饮食。
words.en: A healthy diet is one that helps to maintain or improve overall health. It provides the body with essential nutrition: fluid, macronutrients, micronutrients, and adequate calories.

words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.ex: Can you help with my homework?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我做作业吗？
words.en: To provide assistance or support with a task.

words.ex: He helps out at the store after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后在商店帮忙。
words.en: To assist someone in doing something or in a difficult situation.

words.ex: She walks in high heels to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着高跟鞋去参加派对。
words.en: High heels are women's shoes with high, narrow heels.

words.ex: He practices high jump every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午练习跳高。
words.en: An athletic event in which competitors jump over a high bar that is raised until only one competitor can jump over it without dislodging it.

words.ex: He has a historical viewpoint on the war.
words.ex_cn: 他对这场战争有历史性的观点。
words.en: A perspective or interpretation based on historical events or analysis.

words.ex: They hold a reception after the wedding ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他们在婚礼仪式后举行招待会。
words.en: To organize and host an event where guests are welcomed and entertained, often to celebrate a special occasion or to provide a formal welcome.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；支撑；继续下去；推举；阻挡；拦截；持械抢劫
words.ex: He held up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To hold something up means to keep it in a high position so that it does not fall or to support it. It can also mean to delay or stop the progress of something or someone, or to rob someone using violence or the threat of violence.

words.ex: The teacher made a home visit to see the student's family.
words.ex_cn: 老师进行了家访，看望了学生的家人。
words.en: A home visit is a visit made by a professional, such as a teacher or social worker, to a person's home, typically to provide services or support.

words.tr: phrase. 寄宿家庭；接待留学生的家庭
words.ex: I live with a host family in Canada.
words.ex_cn: 我在加拿大和一个寄宿家庭住在一起。
words.en: A family that provides accommodation and meals for a student or traveler, often in exchange for payment or as part of a cultural exchange program.

words.ex: The microwave is a common household appliance.
words.ex_cn: 微波炉是一种常见的家用电器。
words.en: A household appliance is a device or machine that is used in the home, typically for tasks such as cooking, cleaning, or food preservation.

words.ex: They plan their household budget every month.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个月都规划家庭预算。
words.en: A household budget is a plan for managing the income and expenses of a household over a period of time.

words.ex: They sort household waste every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周分类家庭垃圾。
words.en: Household waste refers to the waste materials produced by households, including food waste, packaging, paper, and other disposable items.

words.ex: The bird hover around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 鸟在树周围盘旋。
words.en: To remain in one place in the air by moving the wings or using engine power.

words.ex: They go to the forest to hunt for food.
words.ex_cn: 他们去森林里寻找食物。
words.en: To search for something or someone very carefully and thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 熙熙攘攘；忙碌喧嚣
words.ex: The hustle and bustle of the city wakes me up every morning.
words.ex_cn: 城市的喧嚣每天早上都把我吵醒。
words.en: The term 'hustle and bustle' refers to the busy and noisy activity of a lot of people in a particular place.

words.ex: He made illegal profit by selling fake goods.
words.ex_cn: 他通过销售假冒商品获得非法利润。
words.en: Profit obtained through illegal means, such as fraud, tax evasion, or other unlawful activities.

words.ex: They want to immigrate to Canada.
words.ex_cn: 他们想移民到加拿大。
words.en: To come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The immune system fights germs in the body.
words.ex_cn: 免疫系统在体内对抗细菌。
words.en: The immune system is the body's defense against infectious organisms and other invaders. Through a series of steps called the immune response, the immune system attacks organisms and substances that invade body systems and cause disease.

words.tr: phrase. 把…硬加给；利用；欺骗；勉强（某人）做事
words.ex: They should not impose on others without asking first.
words.ex_cn: 他们不应该在没有询问的情况下强加于人。
words.en: To impose on someone means to ask them to do something that may be inconvenient or troublesome for them.

words.tr: phrase. 征收；强加于；利用；占便宜
words.ex: The government will impose upon the new tax on luxury goods.
words.ex_cn: 政府将对奢侈品征收新税。
words.en: To place or set (something) on or over something else; to establish or apply as compulsory; to take unfair advantage of someone.

words.ex: He is in a dilemma about which job to take.
words.ex_cn: 他正陷入两难，不知道该选哪份工作。
words.en: In a difficult situation where a choice has to be made between two or more alternatives that are equally undesirable.

words.tr: phrase. 混乱；一团糟；陷于窘境
words.ex: His room is in a mess.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间乱七八糟。
words.en: If something is in a mess, it is in a state of confusion or disorder.

words.tr: phrase. 处在可以…的位置上；能够
words.ex: He is in a position to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is in a position to do something, they have the ability, power, or opportunity to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 在衰退中；处于低迷期
words.ex: He is in a slump after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后陷入低谷。
words.en: Experiencing a period of low performance or activity.

words.ex: In a way, he is right about the problem.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他对这个问题的看法是正确的。
words.en: To some extent; from a certain point of view.

words.ex: He is lazy, in a word.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他很懒。
words.en: used to give a summary or to introduce a conclusion

words.ex: He acted in accordance with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他按照规则行事。
words.en: If something is done in accordance with a particular rule or system, it is done in the way that the rule or system says that it should be done.

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 宽泛地讲；总体来说
words.ex: In broad terms, he likes sports.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢运动。
words.en: If you describe something in broad terms, you describe it in a general way, without giving details.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.tr: phrase. 在流通中；在从事社交活动中；在书库里
words.ex: The coins are in circulation now.
words.ex_cn: 这些硬币现在正在流通。
words.en: If something such as money is in circulation, it is being used by the public. If an idea or story is in circulation, it is being passed around among a group of people.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison to his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences between them.

words.ex: He runs fast, in comparison with his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，与他哥哥相比。
words.en: Used to say that something is being considered in relation to something else, especially to show how they are different or similar.

words.ex: The cat is in danger from the big dog.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫正处在大狗的危险中。
words.en: At risk of harm, injury, or loss.

words.ex: He explained the plan in detail.
words.ex_cn: 他详细地解释了这个计划。
words.en: Including all the facts or aspects of a situation.

words.ex: He is in employment at a local store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家本地商店工作。
words.en: If someone is in employment, they have a job and are working for an employer.

words.ex: The cherry trees are in full blossom.
words.ex_cn: 樱花树正盛开着。
words.en: When a tree or plant is in full blossom, it has all its flowers open.

words.ex: He is in favour of eating more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favour of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 通常；大体上；一般而言
words.ex: In general, he likes to eat fruit.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，他喜欢吃水果。
words.en: Usually; in most cases.

words.tr: phrase. 非常需要的；销路好的
words.ex: Good teachers are in demand.
words.ex_cn: 好老师很受欢迎。
words.en: If someone or something is in demand, they are wanted or required by a lot of people.

words.ex: Good teachers are in great demand.
words.ex_cn: 好老师非常紧缺。
words.en: If something is in great demand, it is wanted or needed by a lot of people.

words.ex: The birds sing in harmony with the wind.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿与风一起和谐地歌唱。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing because all the parts seem to fit together well.

words.tr: phrase. 符合；一致；与…成一直线
words.ex: His decision is in line with the company's rules.
words.ex_cn: 他的决定符合公司的规定。
words.en: In agreement or conformity with something.

words.ex: Eat sweets in moderation.
words.ex_cn: 适量吃甜食。
words.en: In amounts that are not excessive.

words.ex: In most cases, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 在大多数情况下，他步行去学校。
words.en: In the majority of instances or situations.

words.ex: He is in need of help with his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If someone or something is in need of something, they need it.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 在某种程度上；部分地
words.ex: He succeeded in part because he worked hard.
words.ex_cn: 他部分成功是因为他努力工作。
words.en: To some extent; not completely.

words.ex: I like fruits, in particular apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Especially; more than other things or people.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.tr: phrase. 在适当的位置；适当
words.ex: The books are in place on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书整齐地放在书架上。
words.en: In the correct position or location; ready for use.

words.ex: He smiled in reaction to her joke.
words.ex_cn: 他因为她的笑话笑了。
words.en: In response to something, especially something that has happened or been said.

words.ex: He explained the rule in relation to the example.
words.ex_cn: 他结合例子解释了这个规则。
words.en: Concerning or in connection with something.

words.ex: This book is about plants, with relation to their growth.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于植物及其生长的。
words.en: in connection with; concerning

words.ex: Water is in short supply during the drought.
words.ex_cn: 干旱期间，水很短缺。
words.en: If something is in short supply, there is very little of it available and it is difficult to find or obtain.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: The apples are in stock.
words.ex_cn: 苹果有货。
words.en: Available for sale or use; in the store or warehouse.

words.tr: phrase. 贮藏着；准备着；保存着
words.ex: There is a surprise in store for you.
words.ex_cn: 为你准备了一个惊喜。
words.en: If something is in store for you, it is going to happen to you in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.tr: phrase. 如果是那样的话；在那种情况下
words.ex: He didn't bring his book; in that case, I'll lend you mine.
words.ex_cn: 他没带书；那样的话，我借给你我的。
words.en: If that is the situation, then...

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

words.tr: phrase. 首先；从一开始；压根
words.ex: I didn't go out in the first place.
words.ex_cn: 我根本就没出去。
words.en: used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce the first of several reasons, facts, or points that you want to make

words.ex: The park is in the heart of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园位于城市的中心。
words.en: Located in the central or most important part of something.

words.ex: In the majority, students like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 大多数学生喜欢披萨。
words.en: If a group is in the majority, they form more than half of a larger group.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.ex: He stopped walking in the middle of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他在路中间停了下来。
words.en: If you are in the middle of doing something, you are busy doing it.

words.ex: The cabin is in the middle of nowhere, far from any town.
words.ex_cn: 小屋位于荒无人烟的地方，远离任何城镇。
words.en: In a place that is remote and far from any towns or cities.

words.tr: phrase. 处在那个位置；处于那种境况
words.ex: He cannot move in that position.
words.ex_cn: 他不能在那个位置移动。
words.en: phrase. In a particular place or situation.

words.ex: The birds live in the region of the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在山区。
words.en: used to indicate that an amount or number is approximate

words.ex: He likes jazz music, and his brother likes music in the same vein.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢爵士乐，他哥哥也喜欢类似的音乐。
words.en: In a similar style or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 在这种情况下；在这个案例中；既然这样
words.ex: He is late, in this case, he should call the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，在这种情况下，他应该给老师打电话。
words.en: Under the particular circumstances being discussed.

words.ex: There are 5 apples and 3 oranges, in total 8 fruits.
words.ex_cn: 有5个苹果和3个橙子，总共8个水果。
words.en: as a whole; including everything or everyone

words.ex: He is in the faculty of science at the university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的科学系。
words.en: Part of a specific department or group within a university.

words.ex: The incineration plant burns trash to make energy.
words.ex_cn: 焚烧车间焚烧垃圾以产生能源。
words.en: A facility designed for the combustion of waste materials to reduce their volume and produce energy.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.ex: He showed indifference to his friend's problems.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的问题表现出冷淡。
words.en: Indifference is the state of being indifferent, especially in the sense of not caring or being uninterested.

words.ex: Each student's financial aid depends on their individual circumstance.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生的经济援助取决于他们的个人情况。
words.en: A particular situation affecting one person.

words.ex: He asked for help at the information desk.
words.ex_cn: 他在信息台寻求帮助。
words.en: A place in a public building where you can go to get information.

words.ex: The information explosion makes it hard to find true news.
words.ex_cn: 信息爆炸使找到真实新闻变得困难。
words.en: The rapid increase in the amount of information available, especially due to the advent of the internet and digital technologies.

words.ex: He has insight into how the machine works.
words.ex_cn: 他了解这台机器的工作原理。
words.en: An understanding of the true nature of something.

words.ex: He insists on walking to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持每天步行上学。
words.en: If you insist on something, you demand it and refuse to accept any alternative.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: He drinks instant coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝速溶咖啡。
words.en: Instant coffee is a beverage derived from brewed coffee beans that enables people to quickly prepare hot coffee by adding hot water or milk to the powder or concentrated liquid and stirring.

words.tr: phrase. 一出现就大受欢迎的东西
words.ex: The song became an instant hit on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上立即走红。
words.en: Something that becomes very successful or popular very quickly.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: The money is insufficient for buying a new car.
words.ex_cn: 这笔钱不足以买一辆新车。
words.en: If something is insufficient for a particular purpose, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough for that purpose.

words.ex: It is important to integrate into the community when you move to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 当你搬到一个新城市时，融入社区很重要。
words.en: To integrate into something means to become part of a group or system, or to make someone or something become part of a group or system.

words.ex: The library offers an inter-library service to borrow books from other libraries.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆提供馆际服务，可以从其他图书馆借书。
words.en: A service that allows libraries to borrow books and other materials from each other.

words.ex: He works in international trade.
words.ex_cn: 他从事国际贸易。
words.en: The exchange of goods and services between countries.

words.ex: I will introduce my friend to my teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我要把我的朋友介绍给我的老师。
words.en: To present someone to another person, especially formally, so that they can know each other.

words.ex: They will iron out the problems tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天会解决这些问题。
words.en: To resolve or eliminate difficulties or problems.

words.tr: phrase. 不可逆性损伤；无可挽回的破坏
words.ex: The accident caused irreversible damage to his spine.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故对他的脊柱造成了不可逆转的损伤。
words.en: Irreversible damage refers to harm or injury that cannot be undone or reversed, often leading to permanent loss or change.

words.tr: phrase. ...是不明智的；...是不合常理的
words.ex: It makes no sense to buy a car if you walk to work.
words.ex_cn: 如果你走路去上班，买汽车是不明智的。
words.en: It is illogical or pointless to do something.

words.w: it's a pleasure for to do
words.tr: phrase. 对…来说做…是一件愉快的事情
words.uk: ɪts ə ˈpleʒə fɔː tuː duː
words.us: ɪts ə ˈpleʒər fɔːr tuː duː
words.ex: It's a pleasure for me to help you.
words.ex_cn: 我很乐意帮助你。
words.en: Used to express that doing something is enjoyable or satisfying for someone.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.tr: phrase. 对...来说做...变得很有必要
words.ex: Clean water becomes absolutely essential for children to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 清洁的水对孩子们保持健康变得很有必要。
words.en: Used to indicate that something becomes completely necessary for someone to do.

words.w: it's no exaggeration to say that
words.uk: ɪts nəʊ ɪɡˌzædʒəˈreɪʃ(ə)n tuː seɪ ðæt
words.us: ɪts nəʊ ɪɡˌzædʒəˈreɪʃ(ə)n tuː seɪ ðæt
words.ex: It's no exaggeration to say that she is the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 说她是班上最好的学生一点也不夸张。
words.en: Used to emphasize that a statement is completely true and not an overstatement.

words.ex: It is worthwhile to learn a new language.
words.ex_cn: 学习一门新语言是值得的。
words.en: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful enough to make the effort or money spent on it seem reasonable.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必要的；必然的；
words.ex: Water is necessary for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命所必需的。
words.en: If something is necessary, it is needed in order for something else to happen or be done.

words.tr: phrase. 职位描述；工作描述；职责说明
words.ex: He read the job description before the interview.
words.ex_cn: 他在面试前读了职位描述。
words.en: A job description is a written account of all the duties and responsibilities involved in a particular job or position.

words.ex: His job responsibility is to clean the office every day.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作职责是每天打扫办公室。
words.en: A job responsibility refers to the duties and tasks that an individual is expected to perform in their role within an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 两人共有的银行账户；联合账户
words.ex: They have a joint account for their rent and groceries.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个共同账户用于支付房租和杂货。
words.en: A joint account is a bank account shared by two or more individuals, typically used for managing shared expenses or assets.

words.ex: They made a joint effort to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们共同努力完成了这个项目。
words.en: An act or instance of two or more parties working together towards a common goal.

words.ex: He forgot his keys, but just as well, the door was open.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了带钥匙，但也好，门是开着的。
words.en: Used to say that it is a good thing that something happened or was done because if it had not, the situation would be worse.

words.ex: He runs every morning to keep fit.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上跑步以保持健康。
words.en: To maintain one's health and physical condition through regular exercise and a healthy diet.

words.ex: I keep in touch with my friend by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 存档；把…归档；把…记录在案
words.ex: The company will keep your resume on file for six months.
words.ex_cn: 公司会将你的简历存档六个月。
words.en: To retain a document or piece of information for future reference or use.

words.ex: Keep this rule in mind when you write essays.
words.ex_cn: 当你写文章时，要记住这个规则。
words.en: If you keep something in mind, you remember it and take it into account in the future.

words.ex: He likes to keep to himself and doesn't talk much.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢独来独往，不太说话。
words.en: To remain private or secret; to not share one's thoughts or feelings with others.

words.ex: The guard keeps watch on the gate at night.
words.ex_cn: 警卫晚上守着大门。
words.en: To keep watch on something or someone means to observe them carefully in order to notice any signs of danger or unusual activity.

words.ex: He goes to a keep-fit studio every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身工作室。
words.en: A keep-fit studio is a place where people go to exercise and improve their physical fitness.

words.ex: They kick him out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他踢出房间。
words.en: To force someone to leave a place or organization.

words.ex: The disease killed off many animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病导致森林里的许多动物死亡。
words.en: To kill off means to cause the death of all members of a group or species, or to end something completely.

words.ex: I kind of like pizza.
words.ex_cn: 我有点喜欢披萨。
words.en: To some extent; somewhat.

words.tr: phrase. 击倒；拆卸；拍板成交；获得（收入）；降低（价格）；减（量）
words.ex: The strong wind can knock down the small tree.
words.ex_cn: 强风能把小树吹倒。
words.en: To knock someone or something down means to cause them to fall to the ground by hitting them, often with a vehicle or by physical force.

words.tr: phrase. 全面而深入地了解...
words.ex: He knows the math rules backwards and forwards.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学规则了如指掌。
words.en: To know something extremely well.

words.ex: He is known as a good teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位好老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: The city closed the old landfill site last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这座城市关闭了旧的垃圾填埋场。
words.en: A landfill site is a place where waste materials are buried in the ground.

words.tr: phrase. 最后但同样重要的
words.ex: Last but not least, don't forget to bring your ID.
words.ex_cn: 最后但同样重要的是，别忘了带你的身份证。
words.en: used to say that the last person or thing mentioned is as important as the others

words.ex: He paid the late fee for his library book.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的图书馆书籍支付了滞纳金。
words.en: A late fee is an additional charge that is applied to an account when a payment is not received by the due date.

words.ex: The company will launch new products next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将推出新产品。
words.en: To introduce new products to the market.

words.ex: He paid the laundry fee for his clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的衣服支付了洗衣费。
words.en: A charge for washing clothes, linens, etc., often applied by hotels or laundromats.

words.ex: His mistake led into a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他的错误引起了一场大争吵。
words.en: To introduce or begin a discussion, story, or event.

words.ex: The path will lead to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路会把人带到公园。
words.en: If an action or event leads to a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 通过…学习；通过…了解
words.ex: Children learn through playing and exploring.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们通过玩耍和探索来学习。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr: phrase. 讲授…；作...方面的演讲
words.ex: He gave a lecture on math basics.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一场关于数学基础的讲座。
words.en: To give a talk or speech about a particular subject, especially as part of a teaching process.

words.tr: phrase. 录取通知书；接受函
words.ex: He received a letter of acceptance from the university.
words.ex_cn: 他收到了大学的录取信。
words.en: A letter of acceptance is a formal letter sent by an educational institution to a candidate, offering them a place in a course or program.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure time.
words.ex_cn: 他在闲暇时间读书。
words.en: Leisure time refers to the time when one is not working or occupied; free time.

words.ex: Can you lend an ear to my problem?
words.ex_cn: 你能听一听我的问题吗？
words.en: To listen to someone, especially in a sympathetic way.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a letter of recommendation.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师写一封推荐信。
words.en: A letter of recommendation is a letter in which the writer describes the qualities, skills, and achievements of a person they know well, with the purpose of supporting that person's application for a job, admission to a school, or other opportunities.

words.tr: phrase. 预期寿命；平均寿命
words.ex: Life expectancy has increased in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多国家的预期寿命已经增加。
words.en: The average period that a person may expect to live.

words.ex: The city built a new light rail to help people travel faster.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市新建了一条轻轨，以帮助人们更快出行。
words.en: A light rail is a form of urban rail public transportation that generally has a lower capacity and lower speed than heavy rail and metro systems, but higher capacity and higher speed than traditional street-running tram systems.

words.ex: The children line up to enter the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们排队进入教室。
words.en: To arrange people or things in a row or to arrange for an event or activity to happen.

words.ex: We enjoy live music at the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们喜欢在周末去公园听现场音乐。
words.en: Music that is performed in front of an audience, as opposed to music that is recorded and listened to at home.

words.tr: phrase. 生活条件；生存现状
words.ex: The government improved the living condition of poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府改善了贫困家庭的生活条件。
words.en: The circumstances affecting the way in which people live, especially with regard to their well-being.

words.ex: The local resident walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位当地居民每天早上都遛狗。
words.en: A local resident is someone who lives in a particular area or community.

words.ex: He logs on to his computer every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录电脑。
words.en: To log on is to access a computer system or network by entering your username and password.

words.ex: He logs in to his email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上登录邮箱。
words.en: To enter a computer system or website by typing your username and password.

words.ex: He practices long jump every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习跳远。
words.en: The long jump is a track and field event in which athletes combine speed, strength, and agility in an attempt to leap as far as possible from a take-off point.

words.tr: phrase. 向前看；为将来打算
words.ex: We need to look ahead and plan for the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要展望未来并为将来做计划。
words.en: To think about what will happen in the future and plan for it.

words.ex: He looks back on his childhood with happiness.
words.ex_cn: 他满怀幸福地回忆自己的童年。
words.en: To look back means to think about something that happened in the past.

words.ex: I look forward to the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我期待着周末。
words.en: If you look forward to something that is going to happen, you want it to happen because you think you will enjoy it.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.ex: I look up the word in the dictionary.
words.ex_cn: 我在字典里查这个词。
words.en: If you look up a fact or a piece of information, you find it by looking in something such as a reference book or a list.

words.ex: He drove so fast that he lost sight of the road.
words.ex_cn: 他开得太快，看不见路了。
words.en: If you lose sight of something, you forget about it or stop thinking about it because you are focusing on other things.

words.ex: He loses temper when he hears loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 他听到大声噪音时会发脾气。
words.en: If you lose your temper, you become very angry.

words.ex: He bought a lottery ticket last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周买了一张彩票。
words.en: A lottery ticket is a piece of paper that you buy in order to have a chance of winning a prize in a lottery.

words.ex: The government tried to lower the rate of inflation.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图降低通货膨胀率。
words.en: To reduce the rate of something.

words.ex: He chose a low-risk investment to save for retirement.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一种低风险投资来为退休储蓄。
words.en: An investment that is considered to have a minimal chance of losing the principal or the invested amount.

words.ex: His loyalty to his friends never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的忠诚从未改变。
words.en: The quality of being loyal to someone or something.

words.ex: Lucky you, you got a free ticket!
words.ex_cn: 你真幸运，你得到了一张免费票！
words.en: An expression used to tell someone that they are fortunate or lucky.

words.ex: The main topic of the meeting is budget cuts.
words.ex_cn: 会议的主要话题是预算削减。
words.en: The principal subject or theme of a discussion, lecture, or piece of writing.

words.ex: Lucky you, you got a free ticket!
words.ex_cn: 你真幸运，你得到了一张免费票！
words.en: An expression used to tell someone that they are fortunate or lucky.

words.ex: The kind boy made a deep impression on everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个善良的男孩给每个人都留下了深刻的印象。
words.en: To make a deep impression means to have a strong effect on someone's feelings or thoughts, so that they remember it clearly.

words.ex: They make a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To take a longer, indirect route instead of going directly to a destination.

words.tr: phrase. 大获成功；受到好评
words.ex: The new song made a hit on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 这首新歌在广播上大受欢迎。
words.en: To achieve success or popularity, especially in entertainment or media.

words.ex: The library will make a nominal charge for lost books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆对丢失的书将收取少量费用。
words.en: To charge a very small, symbolic fee rather than a substantial amount.

words.ex: Please make note of the homework deadline.
words.ex_cn: 请记下作业的截止日期。
words.en: To write down or remember something important.

words.ex: Make a note of the meeting time.
words.ex_cn: 把会议时间记下来。
words.en: To write down something so that you will remember it.

words.ex: He made a provisional booking for the hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他为酒店做了一个临时预订。
words.en: To arrange a booking that is not yet confirmed and may be changed or cancelled.

words.tr: phrase. 快速离开；迅速逃脱
words.ex: The thief stole the bag and made a quick getaway.
words.ex_cn: 小偷偷了包，迅速逃跑了。
words.en: To leave a place quickly and suddenly, especially to avoid trouble.

words.ex: He made a reference to his teacher in the speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中提到了他的老师。
words.en: To mention or allude to something in speech or writing.

words.ex: Close your eyes and make a wish.
words.ex_cn: 闭上眼睛许个愿。
words.en: To express a desire for something that is not easily attainable or that one hopes will happen.

words.ex: Teachers must make allowances for students who are sick.
words.ex_cn: 老师必须为生病的学生做出适当考虑。
words.en: To take into consideration the circumstances or difficulties of someone or something.

words.ex: He makes an effort to wake up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力早起。
words.en: To try hard to do something.

words.ex: He makes efforts to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To try hard to do something.

words.ex: He made an exception for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他为他妹妹破了例。
words.en: To allow someone or something to be treated differently from the usual rule.

words.ex: The teacher will make an exception of you if you have a good reason.
words.ex_cn: 如果你有充分的理由，老师会对你破例的。
words.en: To treat someone or something in a different way than usual, especially by allowing something that is not normally allowed.

words.ex: Please make clear your answer so everyone can understand.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的答案说清楚，以便每个人都能理解。
words.en: To make something understood or known in a way that is unambiguous.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: He wants to make friends with the new student.
words.ex_cn: 他想和新同学交朋友。
words.en: To become friendly with someone, or to start a friendship with them.

words.ex: He is making great progress in English.
words.ex_cn: 他在英语方面取得了很大进步。
words.en: To achieve significant improvement or advancement in a particular area.

words.ex: We are making headway in our English study.
words.ex_cn: 我们在英语学习上取得了进展。
words.en: To make progress, especially in a difficult situation.

words.w: make it difficult for ... to do
words.tr: phrase. 对…来说做…是一件困难的事情
words.uk: meɪk ɪt ˈdɪfɪkəlt fɔː tuː duː
words.us: meɪk ɪt ˈdɪfɪkəlt fɔːr tuː duː
words.ex: Bad weather makes it difficult for birds to fly.
words.ex_cn: 恶劣的天气让鸟类难以飞行。
words.en: To create conditions that hinder or complicate the ability of someone or something to perform a specific action.

words.ex: He makes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information or thoughts, especially in order to remember them or refer to them later.

words.ex: It makes my blood boil when people are unfair to animals.
words.ex_cn: 当人们不公平地对待动物时，我就气得发疯。
words.en: To cause someone to become extremely angry.

words.ex: They make paper out of wood.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木材制造纸张。
words.en: To create or produce something using a particular material or thing.

words.ex: I need to make seat reservation for the train.
words.ex_cn: 我需要为火车预订座位。
words.en: To arrange for a seat to be kept for someone, especially on a plane, train, or in a theater.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.ex: He made up his mind to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他下定决心戒烟。
words.en: To decide something after considering it carefully.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.ex: He makes use of old books to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他利用旧书来省钱。
words.en: To use something or someone in order to achieve a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 兴风作浪；制造纠纷
words.ex: He made waves by speaking truth to power.
words.ex_cn: 他敢于对权势说真话，引起了轰动。
words.en: To cause trouble or controversy, or to attract attention by doing something unusual or unexpected.

words.tr: phrase. 作出结论；得出结论
words.ex: After the experiment, they made the conclusion.
words.ex_cn: 实验结束后，他们作出了结论。
words.en: To reach a final judgment or decision after considering evidence.

words.ex: He draw the wrong conclusion from the facts.
words.ex_cn: 他从事实中得出了错误的结论。
words.en: To form a specific type of judgment or opinion based on evidence.

words.tr: phrase. 年度风云人物；年度新闻人物
words.ex: He is the man of the year for his charity work.
words.ex_cn: 因为他慈善工作，他是年度人物。
words.en: A title given to a man who has made significant contributions or achievements in a particular year, often awarded by a magazine or organization.

words.ex: The management layer decides how the company works.
words.ex_cn: 管理层决定公司如何运作。
words.en: The level within an organization at which managerial decisions are made.

words.ex: The satellite is a man-made object in space.
words.ex_cn: 这颗卫星是太空中的人造物体。
words.en: An object created by humans rather than occurring naturally.

words.ex: He prefers to drive a car with manual gear.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢开手动挡汽车。
words.en: A manual gear is a type of transmission in a vehicle that requires the driver to change gears manually.

words.ex: Many thanks to Tom for helping me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 非常感谢汤姆帮我做作业。
words.en: An expression of gratitude to someone for performing an action.

words.ex: He lives in a country with a market economy.
words.ex_cn: 他生活在一个具有市场经济的国家。
words.en: An economic system in which the decisions regarding investment, production, and distribution are guided by the price signals created by the forces of supply and demand.

words.tr: phrase. 市场交易额；市场份额；市场占有率
words.ex: The company increased its market share by lowering prices.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司通过降价增加了市场交易额。
words.en: The proportion of industry sales of a particular product or service that is controlled by a company.

words.ex: He works as a marketing consultant for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他是一家小公司的市场营销顾问。
words.en: A marketing consultant is a professional who provides expert advice to businesses on how to improve their marketing strategies and increase sales.

words.ex: The mass media shows news every day.
words.ex_cn: 大众媒体每天播放新闻。
words.en: The mass media refers to the various means by which information is communicated to large numbers of people, including newspapers, magazines, television, and the internet.

words.ex: The company wants to reach maximum profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司希望今年实现最大利润。
words.en: The highest possible profit that can be achieved from a business or investment.

words.ex: He lives in a medium-sized city near the coast.
words.ex_cn: 他住在沿海的一个中等城市。
words.en: A medium-sized city refers to a city that is neither too large nor too small, typically having a population that is larger than a town but smaller than a major metropolitan area.

words.tr: phrase. 按期；赶上截止日期
words.ex: He must meet the deadline to finish his project.
words.ex_cn: 他必须按时完成项目。
words.en: To complete something by the required time or date.

words.ex: This phone meets my needs.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机满足我的需求。
words.en: To satisfy or fulfill someone's requirements or desires.

words.ex: I met up with my old friend at the grocery store.
words.ex_cn: 我在杂货店偶然碰到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To come together with someone, especially after arranging to do so.

words.ex: I met up with an old friend at the supermarket.
words.ex_cn: 我在超市里意外碰到了一位老朋友。
words.en: To meet someone, especially by arrangement.

words.ex: The drone has military use in spying on enemies.
words.ex_cn: 这种无人机用于侦察敌方。
words.en: The application of something for purposes related to the armed forces.

words.ex: Would you mind doing the dishes after dinner?
words.ex_cn: 你介意晚饭后洗碗吗？
words.en: To be willing to do something, often used as a polite request.

words.ex: I like the movie, mind you, it's a bit slow.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这部电影，你要知道，它有点慢。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that qualifies or contrasts with a previous statement.

words.ex: He misplaces trust in people who are not honest.
words.ex_cn: 他把信任错放在不诚实的人身上。
words.en: To place trust in someone or something inappropriately or mistakenly.

words.ex: They move away from the city to the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们从城市搬到乡村。
words.en: To change from one thing, place, or activity to another.

words.ex: The car will move forward when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会向前移动。
words.en: To move forward means to make progress or to continue in a particular direction or towards a particular goal.

words.tr: phrase. 继续前进；转变话题
words.ex: He decided to move on after the breakup.
words.ex_cn: 分手后，他决定继续前行。
words.en: To continue with your life after you have dealt with a bad experience.

words.tr: phrase. 继续；移到；进一步讨论
words.ex: He finished math and will move on to science.
words.ex_cn: 他完成了数学，接下来要学科学。
words.en: To proceed to the next thing or stage.

words.ex: He got a multiple entry visa for China.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了中国多次入境签证。
words.en: A multiple entry visa is a type of visa that allows the holder to enter and exit a country multiple times within a certain period.

words.ex: He plays a musical instrument every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都演奏一件乐器。
words.en: A musical instrument is a device created or adapted to make musical sounds. In principle, any object that produces sound can be considered a musical instrument—it is through purpose that the object becomes a musical instrument.

words.ex: Countries protect natural resources for future generations.
words.ex_cn: 各国保护自然资源以造福后代。
words.en: Materials or substances occurring in nature which can be exploited for economic gain.

words.ex: They enjoy walking in the natural scenery.
words.ex_cn: 他们喜欢在自然风景中散步。
words.en: Natural scenery refers to the landscape that is not man-made, including mountains, rivers, forests, and other elements of the natural world.

words.ex: Never mind the mistake, let's keep going.
words.ex_cn: 别管那个错误了，我们继续吧。
words.en: You say 'never mind' when you are emphasizing that something is not serious or important, especially when someone is upset about it or you are telling them not to worry about it.

words.ex: The government provides nine-year compulsory education for all children.
words.ex_cn: 政府为所有儿童提供九年义务教育。
words.en: The policy of nine-year compulsory education ensures that all children receive basic education for nine years, typically from primary school to junior high school.

words.ex: There is no charge for parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这里停车免费。
words.en: If there is no charge for something, it means that you do not have to pay for it.

words.ex: Everyone must wear a helmet, no exception.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都必须戴头盔，没有例外。
words.en: If you say that something is no exception, you are emphasizing that it is included in a general statement that you are making.

words.ex: There is no substitute for hard work.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作是无可替代的。
words.en: If you say that there is no substitute for something, you mean that it is the only thing which is really satisfactory or effective in a particular situation.

words.ex: He is a non-native speaker of English.
words.ex_cn: 他不是英语母语者。
words.en: A person who speaks a language that is not their first language.

words.ex: We sat in the non-smoking section at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在餐厅的无烟区就座。
words.en: A part of a public area, especially in a restaurant, where smoking is not allowed.

words.ex: The plane went into a nose dive after the engine failed.
words.ex_cn: 发动机故障后，飞机急剧俯冲。
words.en: A nose dive is a sudden steep fall or drop; a rapid decline or deterioration.

words.tr: phrase. 情况并不总是如此
words.ex: It is not always the case that he arrives late.
words.ex_cn: 他并不总是迟到。
words.en: Indicates that a particular situation or condition does not occur all the time.

words.ex: This document is not for circulation.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件不得外传。
words.en: This term is used to denote items, especially currency or documents, that are not intended for general distribution or use among the public.

words.ex: He does not have a clue about the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完全不知道作业是什么。
words.en: To have no knowledge or understanding about something.

words.tr: phrase. 无意冒犯；请勿见怪；别介意（用于礼貌地表达可能引起不快的意见）
words.ex: I like your hat, no offense.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢你的帽子，没有冒犯的意思。
words.en: Used to indicate that one does not mean to upset or insult someone, even if what one is saying might seem critical or disagreeable.

words.ex: Not only does he play soccer, but he also runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅踢足球，而且还每天跑步。
words.en: Used to emphasize that in addition to the first thing mentioned, the second thing is also true and often even more significant.

words.tr: phrase.  更不必说；不必提及
words.ex: He can run fast, not to mention jump high.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快，更不用说跳得高了。
words.en: Used to introduce an additional point which reinforces the point being made.

words.ex: It is not magic but rather science.
words.ex_cn: 这并不是魔法，而实际上是科学。
words.en: Used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or corrects a previous statement, emphasizing the latter as the true or more accurate one.

words.ex: Please note down the homework in your notebook.
words.ex_cn: 请把作业记在你的笔记本上。
words.en: To write something down so that you will remember it.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: phrase. 核心家庭（只包括父母和子女的家庭）
words.ex: He lives with his parents and sister in a nuclear family.
words.ex_cn: 他和父母及妹妹生活在一个核心家庭中。
words.en: A nuclear family is a family group consisting of two parents and their children.

words.ex: The nurse provides nursing care to the old man every day.
words.ex_cn: 护士每天为这位老人提供护理。
words.en: The provision of care by nurses or other qualified healthcare professionals to individuals who are unable to care for themselves due to illness, injury, or disability.

words.ex: The ocean current moves slowly across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 洋流在海中缓慢流动。
words.en: An ocean current is a continuous, directed movement of seawater generated by forces acting upon this mean flow, such as breaking waves, wind, the Coriolis effect, cabbeling, and temperature and salinity differences.

words.ex: He lives off campus near the bus stop.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校外，靠近公交车站。
words.en: Off campus refers to activities or locations that are situated away from the university or college grounds.

words.ex: He went off topic during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议中跑题了。
words.en: Not related to the subject being discussed.

words.tr: phrase. 给...提供机会做某事
words.ex: The program offers opportunity for students to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目为学生提供了学习英语的机会。
words.en: To provide a chance or possibility for someone to do something.

words.ex: The school gives opportunity for students to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 学校给学生提供了学习英语的机会。
words.en: To provide a chance for someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 职员；办公室工作人员
words.ex: The office staff answers phone calls every day.
words.ex_cn: 办公室职员每天接听电话。
words.en: The people who work in an office, performing various administrative and clerical tasks.

words.tr: phrase. 运气好；进展顺利；处于...势头
words.ex: He is on a roll and wins three games in a row.
words.ex_cn: 他状态正佳，连续赢了三场比赛。
words.en: If someone is on a roll, they are having a series of successes.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.ex: He is traveling on business.
words.ex_cn: 他出差。
words.en: If someone is on business, they are away from their usual place of work because they are doing something connected with their job.

words.ex: He lives on campus near the library.
words.ex_cn: 他住在校园里，靠近图书馆。
words.en: On campus refers to being within the area of land that a college or university occupies, including its buildings and grounds.

words.ex: The paintings are on display in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这些画在博物馆里展出。
words.en: If something is on display, it is arranged for people to look at in a public place.

words.ex: We have enough food on hand for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们手头有足够的食物用于聚会。
words.en: Available or present; ready for use.

words.ex: He bought the toy on impulse.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了这个玩具。
words.en: Done suddenly, without careful thought.

words.ex: He spoke at the meeting on my behalf.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上代表我发言。
words.en: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for that person as their representative.

words.ex: He is on his way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: If you are on your way to a place, you are traveling towards it and have not yet arrived.

words.ex: He gave me the book on request.
words.ex_cn: 应我的要求，他给了我这本书。
words.en: If something is available on request, it is available if you ask for it.

words.ex: I will go to the party. On second thoughts, I will stay home.
words.ex_cn: 我会去参加派对。再想想，我还是待在家里吧。
words.en: After reconsidering something; used to introduce a statement that is different from what you said before.

words.ex: The workers are on strike for higher pay.
words.ex_cn: 工人们因加薪而罢工。
words.en: Engaged in a work stoppage as a form of protest.

words.ex: He lives on the margin of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的边缘。
words.en: At the edge or border of something; close to being in a particular state or condition.

words.ex: On the minus side, the job pays very little.
words.ex_cn: 不利的一面是，这份工作薪水很低。
words.en: phrase. Used to introduce a negative aspect or disadvantage of something.

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 用电话交谈；在通话
words.ex: He is talking on the phone with his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他正在和妈妈打电话。
words.en: Using the telephone to communicate with someone.

words.ex: They are on the same wavelength and understand each other easily.
words.ex_cn: 他们想法一致，很容易理解对方。
words.en: If two people are on the same wavelength, they understand each other well because they share the same attitudes, interests, and opinions.

words.tr: phrase. 不好的方面；不利的地位
words.ex: His math skills are on the weaker side.
words.ex_cn: 他的数学能力是不好的方面。
words.en: Phrase. Indicating that something is leaning towards being weaker or less strong in comparison.

words.tr: phrase. 大体上；基本上；总的来说
words.ex: On the whole, the movie was good.
words.ex_cn: 总的来说，这部电影不错。
words.en: You use on the whole to indicate that what you are saying is true in general but may not be true in every case, or that you are giving a general opinion or summary of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在...之上；加之；紧接着
words.ex: The book is on top of the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In addition to; in control of or fully informed about something.

words.tr: phrase. 某人最好的选择；某人最好的办法
words.ex: His best bet is to study hard for the test.
words.ex_cn: 他最好的选择是努力备考。
words.en: The most likely or advisable choice or course of action.

words.ex: This is the best bet to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这是赢得比赛的最佳选择。
words.en: The most advisable or likely course of action.

words.ex: He wants to open a bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他想开一个银行账户。
words.en: To open a bank account means to establish a new account with a bank, allowing one to deposit, withdraw, and manage money.

words.ex: The college has open admission for all high school graduates.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学对所有高中毕业生实行开放录取。
words.en: Open admission refers to a policy or practice in educational institutions where all applicants are accepted without considering their academic records or qualifications.

words.ex: The library has open stacks so students can browse books themselves.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆采用开架式书库，学生可以自行浏览图书。
words.en: Open stacks refer to a library system where books and other materials are directly accessible to the public, as opposed to being stored in closed stacks.

words.ex: He bought an open ticket to visit his family whenever he can.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张不定期机票，以便随时去看望家人。
words.en: An issue or matter that has not been resolved or closed.

words.ex: The library has open shelves for easy access to books.
words.ex_cn: 图书馆设有开架书库，方便读者取阅书籍。
words.en: A system in a library where books are placed on open shelves, allowing readers to access them freely without the need for assistance.

words.tr: phrase. 营业时间；开放时间
words.ex: The shop's opening time is 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 这家店的营业时间是早上8点。
words.en: The time at which a business, establishment, or event starts operating or becomes accessible to the public.

words.tr: phrase. 除了…以外；不包括；绝不是
words.ex: He eats vegetables other than potatoes.
words.ex_cn: 他吃蔬菜，但不吃土豆。
words.en: You use 'other than' after a negative statement to say that the person, item, or thing that follows is the only exception to the statement.

words.ex: You ought to do your homework now.
words.ex_cn: 你现在应该做作业。
words.en: Used to indicate duty or correctness, typically when criticizing someone's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 越界的；禁止入内的
words.ex: The ball went out of bounds during the game.
words.ex_cn: 球在比赛中出了界。
words.en: If something is out of bounds, people are not allowed to do it, go to it, or use it.

words.tr: phrase. 不适合；不相称；不相符
words.ex: He apologized; it was out of character for him to be rude.
words.ex_cn: 他道歉了，他平时不会这么粗鲁。
words.en: If someone's actions are out of character, they do not seem to be the kind of thing that they would usually do.

words.ex: This phone is out of date.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了。
words.en: No longer fashionable or current; obsolete.

words.ex: The book is out of print.
words.ex_cn: 这本书已绝版。
words.en: If a book is out of print, it is no longer being published and you cannot buy new copies of it.

words.tr: phrase. 走样；身体状况不佳
words.ex: The cake came out of shape when I took it out of the oven.
words.ex_cn: 我把蛋糕从烤箱里拿出来时，它已经走样了。
words.en: If someone is out of shape, they are not in good physical condition because they have not been exercising regularly.

words.ex: He is out of temper because his coffee is cold.
words.ex_cn: 他因为咖啡凉了而生气。
words.en: If someone is out of temper, they are angry or in a bad mood.

words.tr: phrase. 在偏僻处；不碍事；罕见
words.ex: The old shed is out of the way, behind the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那个旧棚子在山后面，很偏僻。
words.en: If something is out of the way, it is not blocking a path or is in a remote or isolated location.

words.ex: The book is out on loan to a student.
words.ex_cn: 这本书借给了一名学生。
words.en: If something is out on loan, it has been lent to someone and is not currently available.
