words.ex: He got over and above what he needed.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了比需要的更多的东西。
words.en: In addition to; besides.

words.ex: I talked to my friend over the phone.
words.ex_cn: 我通过电话和朋友聊天。
words.en: If you do something over the phone, you do it using the phone.

words.ex: The overseas student lives in a dormitory.
words.ex_cn: 这位留学生住在宿舍里。
words.en: A student who comes from a foreign country to study in another country.

words.ex: I owe my success to my teacher's help.
words.ex_cn: 我把我的成功归功于老师的帮助。
words.en: If you owe something to someone, you have it because of them or as a result of their actions.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.ex: The pace of life in big cities is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 大城市的快节奏生活非常快。
words.en: The speed at which a person lives their daily life, including work, leisure, and other activities.

words.ex: He made a packing list for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的旅行列了一份行李清单。
words.en: A packing list is a document that lists the items included in a shipment, providing details such as quantity, description, and sometimes the value of the items.

words.ex: He took a pain killer for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一片止痛药来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pain killer is a drug that reduces or eliminates pain.

words.tr: phrase. 平行的；类似的；相同的
words.ex: The road is parallel to the river.
words.ex_cn: 这条路与河流平行。
words.en: If one thing is parallel to another, it happens at the same time as it or is similar to it.

words.ex: The small company is a subsidiary of its parent organization.
words.ex_cn: 这家小公司是其母公司的子公司。
words.en: A parent organization is a company or entity that owns or controls other smaller organizations or subsidiaries.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.ex: He needs a parking permit to park near the office.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张停车许可证才能在办公室附近停车。
words.en: A parking permit is an official document that allows you to park your vehicle in a particular place.

words.ex: He put a parking sticker on his car.
words.ex_cn: 他在车上贴了一张停车证。
words.en: A parking sticker is a permit or label that allows a vehicle to be parked in a designated area.

words.ex: He used his old car in a part exchange for a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的旧车以旧换新换了一辆新车。
words.en: A transaction in which a used item is given as partial payment for a new one.

words.ex: He works a part-time job after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后做一份兼职工作。
words.en: A part-time job is a job in which you work fewer hours each week than people who have a full-time job.

words.ex: He wants to participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他想参加学校的戏剧表演。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: He took a passport photo at the studio.
words.ex_cn: 他在照相馆拍了一张护照照片。
words.en: A photograph that is required for official documents such as passports.

words.ex: He pays a deposit to rent the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他支付押金来租公寓。
words.en: To pay a deposit means to give a sum of money as a first installment or as a pledge for a contract, the balance being payable later.

words.ex: They pay a mortgage every month.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个月还房贷。
words.en: To pay a mortgage is to make regular payments to a lender in order to repay a loan that was used to purchase a property.

words.ex: They pay the mortgage every month.
words.ex_cn: 他们每个月支付房贷。
words.en: To pay the mortgage means to make the required payments on a loan secured by a property. If the payments are not made, the lender has the right to take possession of the property.

words.ex: Please pay attention to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请专心听老师讲课。
words.en: To focus one's mind or efforts on something or someone, especially in order to understand or learn.

words.ex: He will pay for the coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他将为这杯咖啡付款。
words.en: To give money in exchange for goods or services; to suffer the consequences of one's actions.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.ex: They will pay tribute to the hero at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在仪式上向这位英雄致敬。
words.en: To express admiration, respect, or gratitude towards someone or something, often publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 说话时间；发言时间
words.ex: Each student gets two minutes of speak time in the debate.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生在辩论中有两分钟的说话时间。
words.en: A period allocated for speaking or discussion.

words.ex: The cost is $10 per person.
words.ex_cn: 每人费用是10美元。
words.en: For or by each person in a group.

words.ex: He bought personal contents insurance for his laptop and clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的笔记本电脑和衣服购买了个人财物保险。
words.en: Insurance that covers the loss or damage of personal belongings within a home.

words.ex: This book is my personal possession.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的个人物品。
words.en: Personal possession refers to items or property that belong to an individual and are not shared with others.

words.ex: He wrote a personal statement for his college application.
words.ex_cn: 他为大学申请写了一份个人陈述。
words.en: A personal statement is a written account of your personal history, achievements, and goals, often used as part of a college or job application.

words.ex: He filled out a personality questionnaire at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校填了一份性格问卷。
words.en: A personality questionnaire is a psychological tool consisting of a series of questions designed to assess various aspects of an individual's personality.

words.ex: Personally speaking, I like coffee more than tea.
words.ex_cn: 就我个人而言，我更喜欢咖啡而不是茶。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is expressing their own opinion or experience.

words.ex: The manager handles personnel management for the company.
words.ex_cn: 经理负责公司的人员管理。
words.en: Personnel management refers to the administrative discipline of hiring and developing employees so that they become more valuable to the organization.

words.ex: He paid his phone bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天付了电话账单。
words.en: A phone bill is a statement of charges for telephone services, which is sent to a customer regularly, usually monthly.

words.ex: I will phone up my mother tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会给妈妈打电话。
words.en: To call someone on the telephone.

words.ex: He wants to pick my brain about the project.
words.ex_cn: 他想向我请教项目的事情。
words.en: To ask someone for their ideas or opinions on a subject, especially because they know a lot about it.

words.ex: Everyone can pitch in to help clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都可以帮忙打扫公园。
words.en: If people pitch in, they join in and help with an activity.

words.ex: Many tourists visit places of historical interest in Rome.
words.ex_cn: 许多游客参观罗马的历史名胜。
words.en: Locations recognized for their historical significance and appeal to tourists.

words.ex: I plan on going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: To intend or expect to do something.

words.ex: He threw the plastic bag into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把塑料袋扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: A plastic bag is a type of container made of thin, flexible, plastic film, nonwoven fabric, or plastic textile. They are used for containing and transporting goods such as foods, produce, powders, ice, magazines, chemicals, and waste. It is a common form of packaging.

words.tr: phrase. 具有重要意义；发挥重要作用
words.ex: Exercise plays a significant role in staying healthy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼在保持健康方面起着重要作用。
words.en: To have an important effect or influence on something.

words.w: plenty of evidence has shown that
words.tr: phrase. 大量的证据已经表明
words.uk: ˈplenti əv ˈevɪdəns hæz ʃəʊn ðæt
words.us: ˈplenti əv ˈevɪdəns hæz ʃəʊn ðæt
words.ex: Plenty of evidence has shown that exercise helps you stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 大量证据表明，锻炼有助于保持健康。
words.en: There is substantial proof indicating that.

words.ex: From my point of view, this is the best choice.
words.ex_cn: 在我看来，这是最好的选择。
words.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

words.ex: He will point out the mistake in the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他将指出这道数学题中的错误。
words.en: To direct someone's attention to a particular fact or detail.

words.ex: The city is dealing with population growth.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市正在应对人口增长。
words.en: The increase in the number of people living in a particular area.

words.ex: Pollution can pose a threat to our health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对我们的健康构成威胁。
words.en: To present a danger or risk to someone or something.

words.ex: He is a postgraduate student in biology.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名生物学的研究生。
words.en: A postgraduate student is someone who is studying for a degree that is higher than the one they received as an undergraduate, typically a master's degree or a PhD.

words.ex: The store talked to a potential customer yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 商店昨天和一个潜在客户交谈了。
words.en: A potential customer is someone who might be interested in buying a product or service from a company.

words.ex: There is a potential problem with the machine.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器有一个潜在的问题。
words.en: A potential problem is a situation or issue that could become a problem in the future.

words.tr: v. 较喜欢；更喜欢；宁愿；
words.ex: I prefer tea to coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

words.tr: phrase. 出席；呈现某人自己
words.ex: He will present himself at the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To appear or attend somewhere, especially formally or officially; to introduce oneself.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent you from getting hurt.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止你受伤。
words.en: If you prevent someone from doing something, you stop them from doing it.

words.ex: The price range of these shoes is from $20 to $50.
words.ex_cn: 这些鞋子的价格范围是20到50美元。
words.en: The range of prices at which something is offered for sale.

words.ex: The price structure of the product is simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个产品的价格结构很简单。
words.en: The arrangement or system of prices for goods or services within a particular market or economy.

words.ex: He prides himself on being honest.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实为傲。
words.en: If you pride yourself on a quality or skill that you have, you are very proud of it because you think it makes you special or successful.

words.ex: He is proficient in speaking English.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长说英语。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you are able to do it well or to a high standard.

words.ex: He is proficient at solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他擅长解决数学问题。
words.en: If you are proficient at something, you are very skilled at it.

words.ex: Her teacher had a profound influence on her life.
words.ex_cn: 她的老师对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: A profound influence is a very great or intense effect that something has on a person or thing.

words.ex: The projection system shows the movie on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 投影系统把电影投射到墙上。
words.en: A projection system is a device or setup that projects images or video onto a surface, typically used in presentations, cinemas, or classrooms.

words.ex: The government wants to promote sustainable development in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望在农村地区促进可持续发展。
words.en: To encourage or support development that meets present needs without compromising future generations.

words.ex: He bought property insurance for his house.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的房子买了财产保险。
words.en: Insurance that provides compensation for damage to or loss of property.

words.ex: He stands up to propose a toast at the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 他在婚礼上站起来致辞敬酒。
words.en: To suggest that people should drink a toast to someone or something.

words.ex: Wear a hat to protect your face from the sun.
words.ex_cn: 戴帽子以保护你的脸免受阳光照射。
words.en: keep something or someone safe from harm or danger

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

words.ex: The public transport system is slow but cheap.
words.ex_cn: 公共交通系统很慢但很便宜。
words.en: A public transport system is a network of vehicles such as buses and trains that operate at regular times on fixed routes and are used by the public.

words.ex: The shop gave out a publicity leaflet with discount offers.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店分发了一份宣传小册子，里面有折扣信息。
words.en: A printed sheet of paper containing information or advertising and usually distributed free.

words.tr: phrase. 拔出；驶离路边；退出
words.ex: He pulled out a coin from his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他从口袋里掏出了一枚硬币。
words.en: To remove something or someone from a place or situation.

words.ex: He pulled up the weed from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他把杂草从花园里拔了出来。
words.en: To pull up means to bring something to a higher position or to stop moving.

words.ex: He punches in at the office every morning at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上9点在办公室打卡上班。
words.en: To record one's arrival at work by inserting a card into a time clock.

words.ex: The punch line made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那句妙语让所有人都笑了。
words.en: The final part of a joke or story that provides the humor or makes a point.

words.ex: He punches out at 5 p.m. every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午五点打卡下班。
words.en: To record the time of one's departure from work by punching a time clock; to hit someone or something with a fist.

words.ex: He does ten push-ups every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做十个俯卧撑。
words.en: A push-up is a physical exercise performed in a prone position by raising and lowering the body using the arms.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 放下；记下；镇压；贬低；削减；杀死
words.ex: He put down his pen and smiled.
words.ex_cn: 他放下笔，笑了。
words.en: To place something on a surface or in a particular position; to write something down; to suppress or end something by force; to criticize someone in a way that makes them seem stupid or unimportant.

words.ex: The teacher puts emphasis on reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调每天阅读。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing.

words.ex: After work, he likes to put his feet up and relax.
words.ex_cn: 下班后，他喜欢放松一下，把脚翘起来。
words.en: To relax, especially by sitting or lying with your feet supported and raised.

words.ex: Smoking puts your health at risk.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟使你的健康处于危险之中。
words.en: To expose someone or something to the possibility of loss, injury, or other adverse effects.

words.tr: phrase. 替...接通与某人的电话；让某人着手某事；吸引某人的注意力
words.ex: Can you put me on to the manager?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我接通经理的电话吗？
words.en: To place something onto a surface or to guide someone towards something.

words.tr: phrase. 为...接通电话；顺利完成
words.ex: I will put you through to the manager.
words.ex_cn: 我将为你接通经理的电话。
words.en: To endure or suffer through a difficult experience.

words.tr: phrase. 在…到…的范围间变动
words.ex: The prices range from $5 to $20.
words.ex_cn: 价格从5美元到20美元不等。
words.en: If things range from one thing to another, they vary within these limits on a scale of measurement or quality.

words.ex: The prices range from 5 to 10 dollars.
words.ex_cn: 价格从5美元到10美元不等。
words.en: To vary or extend between specified limits.

words.tr: phrase. 宁可 ... 也不愿；与其 ... 倒不如；而不是
words.ex: He chose to walk rather than take the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他宁愿走路也不愿坐公交车。
words.en: used to say that one thing is preferred to another or happens instead of another

words.ex: The factory uses raw materials to make products.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用原材料制造产品。
words.en: Raw materials are basic substances that are used to make products or to create energy. They are often natural resources such as oil, wood, or metal.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: To suggest or advise that someone or something is suitable for a purpose.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: He will recover from the flu next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会从流感中康复。
words.en: To recover from something means to return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength after experiencing an illness, injury, or emotional distress.

words.tr: phrase. 查阅；提到；涉及；指的是
words.ex: Please refer to the dictionary for the meaning.
words.ex_cn: 请查阅字典以了解这个词的意思。
words.en: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

words.ex: He asked his teacher for a reference letter.
words.ex_cn: 他请老师给他写一封推荐信。
words.en: A reference letter is a document in which the writer assesses the qualities, characteristics, and capabilities of the person being recommended in terms of that individual's ability to perform a particular task or function.

words.ex: He uses reference materials to find the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他使用参考资料来找到答案。
words.en: Materials that are used to provide information or evidence, especially for academic or professional research.

words.tr: phrase. 咨询号码；参考号码
words.ex: Please call the hotline and give your reference number.
words.ex_cn: 请拨打热线并提供你的咨询号码。
words.en: A reference number is a unique identifier assigned to a specific transaction or document, used for tracking and identification purposes.

words.ex: He checked the reference source for the date.
words.ex_cn: 他查阅了参考资料以确认日期。
words.en: A source from which information or facts can be obtained.

words.ex: The books are on the reference stacks.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在参考书架上。
words.en: The shelves in a library that house the reference collection, which is for in-library consultation and not for borrowing.

words.ex: He refrains from eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他戒糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.ex: He looked at the notes to refresh his memory before the test.
words.ex_cn: 他看了看笔记，以便在考试前唤醒记忆。
words.en: To remind someone of something they have forgotten or to help someone remember something more clearly.

words.tr: phrase. 进修课程；复习课程
words.ex: He took a refresher course in math before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前参加了一个数学复习课程。
words.en: A refresher course is a training course that helps people review and update their knowledge or skills in a particular subject.

words.ex: They regard him as a hero.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他视为英雄。
words.en: To consider or think of someone or something in a specified way.

words.ex: He went for a walk regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去散步了。
words.en: Without taking into account; without being affected by.

words.ex: He must register with the office before Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他必须在周一之前到办公室登记。
words.en: To officially record your name or the details of an event on a list.

words.ex: He sent the letter by registered mail.
words.ex_cn: 他通过挂号信寄出了这封信。
words.en: A type of mail service that provides the sender with a receipt and a record of delivery.

words.tr: phrase. 登记费；挂号费；更名费
words.ex: He paid the registration fee for the course.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了这门课程的注册费。
words.en: A registration fee is a sum of money that you pay to register for something, such as a course, a conference, or a competition.

words.ex: They have a regular meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周一都有一次定期会议。
words.en: A regular meeting is a meeting that occurs at fixed intervals, such as weekly or monthly, to discuss ongoing issues or projects.

words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.ex: The boys ran in a relay race at school.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们在学校参加了接力赛。
words.en: A relay race is a track and field event in which athletes run a set distance with a baton, passing it from one runner to the next.

words.ex: He breathes deeply to release pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他深呼吸来缓解压力。
words.en: To release pressure means to reduce or relieve stress or tension.

words.ex: He follows his religious practice every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循他的宗教习俗。
words.en: Religious practice refers to the activities and rituals that are part of a religion, including worship, prayer, and other ceremonies.

words.ex: He relies on his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依靠弟弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: He relies upon his brother for help.
words.ex_cn: 他依赖他的兄弟帮忙。
words.en: To depend on with full trust or confidence.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: The removals van arrived at noon to take the boxes.
words.ex_cn: 搬家货车中午到达来拉走箱子。
words.en: A removals van is a large vehicle used for transporting furniture and other household items when moving from one house to another.

words.ex: The university does a research assessment every year.
words.ex_cn: 大学每年进行一次研究评估。
words.en: The systematic process of evaluating the quality and impact of research activities and outputs, often used to inform funding decisions, policy making, and academic strategy.

words.ex: He learned research methodology in his master's program.
words.ex_cn: 他在硕士课程中学习了研究方法。
words.en: Research methodology refers to the systematic, theoretical analysis of the methods applied to a field of study.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.ex: He did not respond to the message yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有回复那条信息。
words.en: To react or answer to something, such as a question, request, or situation.

words.ex: The response rate was low in the survey.
words.ex_cn: 调查的回复率很低。
words.en: The proportion of people who respond to a survey, advertisement, or other form of communication.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: Too much sugar can result in health problems.
words.ex_cn: 过多的糖会导致健康问题。
words.en: If something results in a particular situation or event, it causes that situation or event to happen.

words.ex: He hears a ringback tone when he calls his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他打电话给朋友时听到回铃音。
words.en: A ringback tone is the sound that the caller hears while waiting for the call to be answered.

words.ex: The children roam about the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园里四处逛。
words.en: To move about or travel, especially over a wide area, without any definite purpose or destination.

words.ex: We root for our team in every game.
words.ex_cn: 我们在每场比赛中都为我们的队伍加油。
words.en: To support or cheer for someone or something, especially in a competition.

words.ex: He bought a round-trip ticket to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去巴黎的往返票。
words.en: A ticket that allows you to travel to a place and then return back to where you started.

words.ex: He took a roundabout route to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他绕了远路以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A longer, less direct way to go somewhere, often taken to avoid something or to enjoy the journey.

words.tr: phrase. 日常工作；常规作业
words.ex: He does routine work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天做常规工作。
words.en: Regular tasks or duties that are part of one's job or daily life, often considered mundane or repetitive.

words.ex: I run across my old friend at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场遇到了我的老朋友。
words.en: To meet or find someone or something by chance.

words.tr: phrase. 跑进；撞上；偶遇；陷入；达到
words.ex: The dog ran into the house.
words.ex_cn: 狗跑进了房子。
words.en: To meet someone or find something by chance; to experience something unexpectedly; to collide with something.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: He runs risks by driving too fast.
words.ex_cn: 他开得太快，所以冒着危险。
words.en: To take a chance of something bad happening.

words.ex: He will run the risk of losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他将面临失去工作的风险。
words.en: To do something that may result in a particular, usually negative, outcome.

words.tr: phrase. 跑着穿过；刺、戳；贯穿；匆匆处理；排练；划掉；挥霍
words.ex: The dog ran through the park quickly.
words.ex_cn: 狗迅速跑过了公园。
words.en: To go over or examine something quickly; to be present in every part of something; to rehearse a play, piece of music, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 放肆；撒野；不受控制
words.ex: The children run wild in the park every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们每天下午在公园里疯跑。
words.en: If someone or something runs wild, they behave in a natural, free, or uncontrolled way.

words.ex: The traffic is heavy during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段交通很拥堵。
words.en: The rush hour is one of the periods of the day when most people are travelling to or from work.

words.ex: He has to rush off to work now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在得赶紧去上班。
words.en: To leave quickly or in a hurry, often because you need to be somewhere else.

words.tr: phrase. 卫生条件；卫生状况
words.ex: The restaurant failed the inspection due to poor sanitary conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅因卫生条件差而未能通过检查。
words.en: The state of cleanliness and hygiene, especially in public places or facilities.

words.ex: This food satisfies the need of hungry children.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物满足了饥饿孩子们的需求。
words.en: To fulfill or meet the requirements or desires of someone or something.

words.tr: phrase. 保存一个备份副本
words.ex: Save a backup copy of your file before you edit it.
words.ex_cn: 在编辑文件之前，保存一个备份副本。
words.en: To save a backup copy means to store a duplicate version of a file or document as a precaution against data loss.

words.ex: He saves up money to buy a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他存钱买一辆自行车。
words.en: To gradually collect money by saving it, especially for a particular purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 保存票证；保留票据
words.ex: I save ticket for my flight tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我保存了明天航班的票证。
words.en: To preserve a ticket for future use or to keep it from being used.

words.ex: He puts money into his savings account every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周把钱存入他的储蓄账户。
words.en: A savings account is a bank account where you can deposit money that you do not need immediately and earn interest on it.

words.tr: phrase. 安全入口；安检入口
words.ex: The security entrance checks every bag.
words.ex_cn: 安全入口检查每一个包。
words.en: A security entrance is a designated entry point in a building or area that is monitored and controlled to ensure the safety and security of the premises and its occupants.

words.ex: The concert tickets sold out in one hour.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会的票在一小时内就卖光了。
words.en: To sell all of the available items or tickets for an event, so that there are no more left for people to buy.

words.ex: They live in a semi-detached house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一栋半独立式房子里。
words.en: A semi-detached house is a house that is joined to another house on one side by a shared wall.

words.ex: He sends out emails every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发送邮件。
words.en: To cause something to go or be taken to a place, especially by post or by email.

words.ex: The senior citizen walks in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位老年人每天早上在公园散步。
words.en: A senior citizen is an older person who is retired and receives a pension.

words.ex: He served her with a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 他递给她一杯茶。
words.en: To provide someone with something, especially food or drink, as part of a meal or as a way of entertaining them.

words.ex: The restaurant added a service charge to the bill.
words.ex_cn: 餐厅在账单上加了一笔服务费。
words.en: A service charge is an amount of money that is added to your bill in a restaurant or hotel, to pay for the service you have received.

words.tr: phrase. 放置一旁；留出；不理会；取消
words.ex: He sets aside $50 each week for savings.
words.ex_cn: 他每周存下50美元作为储蓄。
words.en: To reserve or keep something for a particular purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 阻碍；延缓；使受挫折；回拨（钟表）
words.ex: The storm set back the construction by two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴把施工推迟了两周。
words.en: To delay or hinder the progress of something.

words.tr: phrase. 制定；（使）放下；（叫…）下车；记下
words.ex: The government set down new rules for safety.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了新的安全规则。
words.en: To place something on a surface or to write or record something officially.

words.tr: phrase. 动身； 出发；着手；陈述
words.ex: They set out early to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他们早早出发去赶公交车。
words.en: To begin a journey or to start doing something with a particular aim.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.tr: phrase. 摆饭桌； 摆餐具
words.ex: She sets the table before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她在晚餐前摆好餐桌。
words.en: To arrange the dishes, glasses, and utensils on a table in preparation for a meal.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.

words.tr: phrase. 定居；平静下来；专心于
words.ex: He wants to settle down with a family.
words.ex_cn: 他想安定下来组建家庭。
words.en: To settle down means to start living in a place where you intend to stay for a long time, usually after moving around a lot.

words.ex: They share the view on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他们对气候变化有相同的看法。
words.en: To express agreement with someone's opinion or perspective.

words.ex: He does shift work at the factory.
words.ex_cn: 他在工厂上夜班。
words.en: Work that is done in shifts, especially in a factory or hospital, where different groups of workers work at different times of the day and night.

words.ex: The movie uses violence for shock value.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影用暴力来制造震撼效果。
words.en: The quality of being shocking or causing surprise, especially in a way that is intended to provoke a strong reaction.

words.ex: They want to shoot a film in the small village.
words.ex_cn: 他们想在那个小村庄拍摄一部电影。
words.en: To make a movie by recording images on film or digitally.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.ex: The factory will shut down next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂下个月将关闭。
words.en: To close something, especially a business or machine, so that it stops operating.

words.ex: The medicine has a side effect of dizziness.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有头晕的副作用。
words.en: An effect of a drug or chemical that is in addition to its intended effect, especially an effect that is harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: This is a famous sightseeing spot in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是这座城市著名的观光景点。
words.en: A place of interest to tourists.

words.ex: He signed a contract with the company last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周和这家公司签了合同。
words.en: To formally agree to a contract with someone or an organization, often by signing a document.

words.tr: phrase. 签约参加工作；签约雇用；报名
words.ex: He signed up for a job at the local factory.
words.ex_cn: 他签约参加了当地工厂的工作。
words.en: To agree to become involved in an organized activity or to join a group or organization.

words.ex: He rides a single-speed cycle to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑一辆单速自行车去上班。
words.en: A bicycle with only one gear ratio, making it simpler and often lighter than multi-speed bicycles.

words.tr: phrase. 照看；代替；静坐示威；出席
words.ex: Can you sit in while I go to the bathroom?
words.ex_cn: 我去上厕所的时候你能照看一下吗？
words.en: To participate in a sit-in; to occupy seats in a public place as a form of protest.

words.tr: phrase. 临时替人照看；与...坐在一起
words.ex: Can you sit with my little brother while I go to the store?
words.ex_cn: 我去商店的时候，你能临时照看下我弟弟吗？
words.en: To be in a seated position with someone or something; to tolerate or accept something.

words.ex: He can slip from truth to lies very quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他能很快从说真话变成说谎。
words.en: to move smoothly and quietly from one place or position to another, especially without being noticed

words.tr: phrase. 匆忙穿上...；在...上滑倒
words.ex: He slipped on his shoes and ran out the door.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙穿上鞋子，冲出了门。
words.en: To put on (a garment) quickly and easily.

words.ex: The car will slow down at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯处会减速。
words.en: To reduce one's speed or the speed of a vehicle or process.

words.tr: phrase. 抢购； 匆匆吃下； 抢先弄到手
words.ex: People snapped up the discounted shoes quickly.
words.ex_cn: 人们迅速抢购了打折的鞋子。
words.en: To buy something quickly and eagerly, often because it is cheap or in limited supply.

words.ex: He likes apples, bananas, and so forth.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果、香蕉等等。
words.en: used at the end of a list to indicate that there are other items that you could also mention

words.ex: The sponge soaks up water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸水。
words.en: To absorb or take in (a liquid, knowledge, or experience) fully.

words.ex: Children learn through social interaction with their peers.
words.ex_cn: 儿童通过与同龄人的社交互动来学习。
words.en: Social interaction refers to the process by which individuals act and react in relation to others. It is a fundamental aspect of human life that encompasses the ways in which people communicate and interact with each other in various contexts.

words.ex: The government helps poor people with social welfare.
words.ex_cn: 政府通过社会福利帮助穷人。
words.en: Social welfare refers to the well-being of a society, often provided through government programs aimed at helping those in need.

words.ex: He buys a soft drink after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后买了一瓶碳酸饮料。
words.en: A soft drink is a drink that does not contain alcohol, especially one that is sweet and usually carbonated.

words.ex: He uses soil conditioner to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他使用土壤改良剂来帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance added to soil to improve its physical properties, especially its ability to provide nutrition for plants.

words.ex: The house uses solar energy to power the lights.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子利用太阳能来供电。
words.en: Solar energy is energy that comes from the sun and is captured using various technologies, primarily solar panels, to generate electricity or heat.

words.tr: phrase. 解决；整理；挑选出；消除误会
words.ex: I need to sort my problems out before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我需要在会议前把我的问题解决掉。
words.en: To resolve a problem or disagreement; to organize or arrange something.

words.ex: That idea sounds good to me.
words.ex_cn: 那个主意听起来不错。
words.en: To seem pleasant, acceptable, or convincing.

words.ex: He reads books in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Spare time refers to the time when one is not working or occupied; leisure time.

words.ex: His words sparked off a big argument.
words.ex_cn: 他的话引起了一场激烈的争吵。
words.en: To cause something to start or happen, especially suddenly.

words.ex: Please speak at natural speed so I can understand you better.
words.ex_cn: 请以自然的速度说话，这样我能更好地理解你。
words.en: To talk at a normal, unhurried pace without artificial speed or slowness.

words.ex: Speak of the devil, he just walked in.
words.ex_cn: 说曹操，曹操就到，他刚走进来。
words.en: To mention or discuss someone or something.

words.ex: He didn't speak up when the teacher asked a question.
words.ex_cn: 老师问问题时，他没有开口。
words.en: to express one's opinions or feelings openly and without fear, especially in a situation where it might be difficult to do so

words.tr: phrase. 为...辩护； 替...讲好话
words.ex: She speaks up for her friend when others are mean.
words.ex_cn: 当别人对她的朋友不友好时，她为朋友发声。
words.en: To defend or support someone or something publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 特殊诊所；专科门诊
words.ex: He goes to a special clinic for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他去一家专科诊所治疗背痛。
words.en: A medical facility or appointment focused on a particular health issue or group.

words.ex: He is taking a specialized course in robotics.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修一门机器人方面的专业课程。
words.en: A course designed to provide in-depth knowledge or training in a specific area of study or profession.

words.ex: He pressed the button to speed up the video.
words.ex_cn: 他按了按钮来加快视频速度。
words.en: To increase the speed or rate of something.

words.ex: The branch split off from the main tree.
words.ex_cn: 这个树枝从主干上分开了。
words.en: If a group splits off or is split off from a larger group, it becomes separate from it.

words.ex: He practices spoken English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习英语口语。
words.en: the use of the English language in speech, as opposed to writing

words.tr: phrase. 恰好的（地）；准确的（地）
words.ex: Your answer is spot on.
words.ex_cn: 你的答案完全正确。
words.en: Exactly right; completely accurate.

words.tr: phrase. 跳起来；发生；迅速发展
words.ex: The ball springs up when it hits the ground.
words.ex_cn: 球碰到地面时跳起来。
words.en: To appear or develop quickly and/or suddenly.

words.ex: Seeds sprout up after rain.
words.ex_cn: 种子在雨后发芽。
words.en: If a large number of things sprout up, they suddenly appear or begin to exist.

words.tr: phrase. 教研室；员工休息室
words.ex: The teachers are having a meeting in the staff room.
words.ex_cn: 老师们正在教研室开会。
words.en: A room in a school or college where teachers can work and relax.

words.tr: phrase. 代表；象征；支持；容忍
words.ex: The letter A stands for apple.
words.ex_cn: 字母A代表苹果。
words.en: If you say that a letter stands for a particular word, you mean that it is an abbreviation for that word.

words.tr: phrase. 引人注目；突出；出色
words.ex: Her red hat makes her stand out in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 她的红帽子让她在人群中很显眼。
words.en: To be very noticeable or obvious, especially in comparison to others.

words.tr: phrase. 生活标准；生活水平
words.ex: His job improved the standard of living for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他的工作改善了家人的生活水平。
words.en: The level of wealth, comfort, material goods, and necessities available to a certain socioeconomic class or a certain geographic area.

words.ex: We start off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey, activity, or process.

words.ex: He wants to start up a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他想开一家小咖啡店。
words.en: To start up means to begin or initiate something, such as a business or a project.

words.tr: phrase. 改过自新；言归于好
words.ex: He started with a clean slate after failing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试失败后从头再来。
words.en: To begin something new without being influenced by past mistakes or problems.

words.ex: The state-run enterprise provides jobs for many people.
words.ex_cn: 这家国营企业为许多人提供了工作。
words.en: A state-run enterprise is a company or business that is owned and controlled by the government.

words.ex: I stay in touch with my old friends by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和老朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.tr: phrase. 保持在预算范围内
words.ex: We must stay within the budget this month.
words.ex_cn: 这个月我们必须在预算范围内。
words.en: To limit spending to a predetermined amount of money.

words.ex: He bought a new stereo system for his living room.
words.ex_cn: 他为客厅买了一个新的音响系统。
words.en: A stereo system is a set of equipment for playing recorded sound, which uses two or more separate speakers to produce a more natural and realistic sound.

words.ex: He drives a car with a stick shift.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆手动挡汽车。
words.en: A stick shift is a manual transmission in a vehicle, operated by a gear lever.

words.ex: The funny story will stick in my mind for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 这个有趣的故事会长时间留在我的记忆里。
words.en: If something sticks in your mind, it remains firmly in your memory.

words.tr: phrase. 粘附；坚持；紧跟；忠于
words.ex: The glue will stick the paper to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水会把纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: If you stick to a promise, agreement, decision, or principle, you do what you said you would do, or do not change your mind.

words.ex: He watches the stock market every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天观看股市。
words.en: The stock market is a place where shares in companies are bought and sold.

words.tr: phrase. 储存起来；收藏起来
words.ex: He likes to store away food for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢为冬天储存食物。
words.en: To put something in a place where it will be kept until it is needed.

words.tr: phrase. 储存；积蓄；积攒（尤指为将来使用）
words.ex: They store up food for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他们为冬天储存食物。
words.en: To accumulate or save something for future use.

words.ex: He left straight away after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后他立刻离开了。
words.en: If you do something straight away, you do it immediately and without delay.

words.ex: He stripped down to his underwear before swimming.
words.ex_cn: 他游泳前脱到了内衣。
words.en: To remove all the clothes from your body or to remove the parts of something so that only the basic structure remains.

words.ex: He strives for success every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在努力追求成功。
words.en: To try very hard to achieve something.

words.ex: He uses his student account to get free software.
words.ex_cn: 他使用学生账户来获取免费软件。
words.en: A bank account specifically designed for students, often offering benefits such as lower fees or special interest rates.

words.ex: The student handbook explains the school rules.
words.ex_cn: 学生手册解释了学校的规定。
words.en: A student handbook is a guide provided by educational institutions to inform students about policies, procedures, and resources available to them.

words.ex: The student union organized a free concert on campus.
words.ex_cn: 学生会在学校组织了一场免费音乐会。
words.en: The student union is an organization found in many colleges, universities, and high schools. In higher education, the student union is often accorded its own building on the campus, dedicated to social, organizational activities, representation, and academic support of the membership.

words.ex: The students' union organized a food drive.
words.ex_cn: 学生会组织了一次食品捐赠活动。
words.en: An organization in a college or university that represents the students and organizes social and other events.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription fee for the app.
words.ex_cn: 他每月为这个应用支付订阅费。
words.en: A subscription fee is a sum of money that you pay regularly to receive a service, especially a magazine or newspaper.

words.ex: He suffers from a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他患了重感冒。
words.en: If you suffer from an illness or from a medical condition, you are badly affected by it.

words.ex: He put his idea in the suggestion box.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的想法投进了意见箱。
words.en: A suggestion box is a device for collecting suggestions, ideas, or feedback from people, typically in a workplace or public space.

words.ex: This shoe is suitable for walking.
words.ex_cn: 这双鞋适合走路。
words.en: If something is suitable for a particular purpose or person, it is right or acceptable for that purpose or person.

words.tr: phrase. 高峰会议；首脑会议
words.ex: The summit conference will happen next month.
words.ex_cn: 峰会将在下个月举行。
words.en: A summit conference is a meeting between the leaders of two or more countries to discuss important issues.

words.ex: The leaders had a summit meeting last week.
words.ex_cn: 领导人上周举行了峰会。
words.en: A summit meeting is a meeting or conference of the highest level officials, especially in international relations.

words.tr: phrase. 比…优越；比…高级；胜过
words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If one thing or person is superior to another, the first is better than the second.

words.ex: He likes to surf the internet after school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢放学后上网。
words.en: To browse the World Wide Web.

words.ex: A cold wind swept across the field.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风扫过田野。
words.en: To move quickly and forcefully across an area, affecting everything in its path.

words.ex: She bought a new swimming costume for the beach.
words.ex_cn: 她为去海滩买了一件新的泳衣。
words.en: A swimming costume is a piece of clothing designed for swimming or other water-based activities.

words.ex: He plays table tennis every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他每天下午打乒乓球。
words.en: Table tennis, also known as ping-pong, is a sport in which two or four players hit a lightweight ball back and forth across a table using small rackets.

words.ex: He takes a sip of water after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后喝了一口水。
words.en: To take a sip of something means to drink a small amount of it.

words.ex: We take a stroll around the park every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天晚上都在公园里散步。
words.en: To walk leisurely around a place.

words.ex: He takes a positive view of the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持积极的看法。
words.en: To have a particular opinion or attitude about something.

words.ex: He takes a positive view of the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来持积极的看法。
words.en: To consider or examine something from a particular perspective or angle.

words.ex: He takes a positive view towards learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他对学习英语持积极态度。
words.en: To have a particular attitude or way of thinking about something.

words.ex: He takes a positive view towards learning English.
words.ex_cn: 他以积极的态度看待学习英语。
words.en: Adopt a particular perspective or attitude when considering a situation.

words.ex: It takes ages to download this file.
words.ex_cn: 下载这个文件要花很长时间。
words.en: If you say that something takes ages, you mean that it takes a very long time.

words.ex: He takes an interest in birds.
words.ex_cn: 他对鸟类感兴趣。
words.en: To become interested in something or someone.

words.ex: Let's take China as an example.
words.ex_cn: 让我们以中国为例。
words.en: To use something or someone as an instance for illustration or explanation.

words.ex: He decided to take control of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他决定掌控自己的生活。
words.en: To take control of something means to gain the power or authority to manage or direct it.

words.ex: The teacher must take account of each student's speed.
words.ex_cn: 老师必须考虑每个学生的进度。
words.en: To consider or pay attention to something when making a decision or judgment.

words.ex: We must take the weather into consideration before planning the trip.
words.ex_cn: 在计划旅行之前，我们必须把天气考虑进去。
words.en: To think about and include something when making a decision or judgment.

words.tr: phrase. 造成重大损失；遭受重创
words.ex: The war took a heavy toll on the people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给人们带来了沉重的打击。
words.en: To cause a significant amount of damage, harm, or suffering, often used to describe the negative impact of events or situations on people or things.

words.tr: phrase. 造成巨大损失；产生不好影响
words.ex: The war took a heavy toll on the people.
words.ex_cn: 战争给人们带来了巨大的伤害。
words.en: To cause a lot of damage, deaths, or suffering to someone or something.

words.ex: Stress can take its toll on your health.
words.ex_cn: 压力会对你的健康造成损害。
words.en: If you say that something takes its toll or takes a heavy toll, you mean that it has a bad effect or causes a lot of suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 给…造成重大伤亡（或损失）；对…产生消极影响
words.ex: Stress can take its toll on your health.
words.ex_cn: 压力会对你的健康造成影响。
words.en: To have a bad effect on someone or something, especially over a long period of time.

words.ex: He takes notes during the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时做笔记。
words.en: To write down information, especially during a lecture or meeting, in order to remember it later.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.tr: phrase. 激动得说不出话来；使某人大为惊讶
words.ex: The view from the mountain takes my breath away.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色让我惊叹不已。
words.en: If something takes your breath away, it is so beautiful, amazing, or surprising that you feel unable to breathe for a moment.

words.ex: He will take over his father's business next year.
words.ex_cn: 他明年将接管他父亲的生意。
words.en: To assume control of someone else's business operations, typically after the previous owner has left or retired.

words.ex: He takes pictures of the sunset every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天傍晚拍夕阳的照片。
words.en: To capture images using a camera.

words.ex: Please take pity on the poor dog and give it some food.
words.ex_cn: 请可怜这只可怜的狗，给它一些食物。
words.en: To feel sympathy for someone because they are in a difficult or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: He will take responsibility for his actions.
words.ex_cn: 他将为自己的行为负责。
words.en: To accept the duty of dealing with or taking care of something or someone, so that you may be blamed if something goes wrong.

words.ex: He took unpaid leave to care for his sick mother.
words.ex_cn: 他请了无薪假来照顾他生病的母亲。
words.en: To take time off from work without receiving pay.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.tr: phrase. 滑石粉；爽身粉；扑粉
words.ex: She uses talcum powder to keep her skin dry.
words.ex_cn: 她使用滑石粉保持皮肤干燥。
words.en: A powder made from talc, used especially for making the skin feel dry or for reducing friction.

words.ex: We need to talk through the plan before we start.
words.ex_cn: 在开始之前，我们需要把计划讨论一下。
words.en: To discuss something thoroughly in order to solve it or understand it better.

words.ex: The government uses tax revenue to build roads.
words.ex_cn: 政府用税收收入来修建道路。
words.en: Tax revenue refers to the income that is gained by governments through taxation.

words.ex: The school has good teaching facilities.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有良好的教学设施。
words.en: Teaching facilities refer to the physical resources and equipment available in educational institutions to support the delivery of instruction and enhance learning experiences.

words.ex: The team showed great team spirit during the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛期间，团队展现了极强的团队精神。
words.en: Team spirit refers to the feelings of camaraderie and enthusiasm for the group that one is part of, especially in a sports team or workplace.

words.ex: He tore down the poster from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把海报从墙上扯了下来。
words.en: To tear down something means to destroy or remove it completely, especially a building or other structure.

words.tr: phrase. 电话面试；电话访谈
words.ex: He had a telephone interview yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天进行了一次电话面试。
words.en: A telephone interview is a conversation between a potential employer and a job applicant conducted over the telephone, typically as an initial screening process.

words.ex: He paid for telephone rental last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月支付了电话租赁费。
words.en: The service of renting telephones to users, typically for a short period of time.

words.tr: phrase. 区分；辨别（常用于 tell A from B 结构，表示‘把A和B区分开’）
words.ex: It is hard to tell the twin brothers from each other.
words.ex_cn: 很难把那对双胞胎兄弟区分开来。
words.en: Distinguish or recognize something by its characteristics or appearance.

words.ex: He tends to arrive late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他总是迟到上课。
words.en: If someone or something tends to do a particular thing, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.tr: phrase. 谢天谢地（表示宽慰或庆幸）
words.ex: Thank goodness the rain stopped before we left.
words.ex_cn: 幸好雨在我们出发前停了。
words.en: An expression of relief or gratitude that something good has happened or that a bad situation has been avoided.

words.ex: Thanks to his help, I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 多亏了他的帮助，我通过了考试。
words.en: used to say that something good has happened because of someone or something

words.tr: phrase. 最不想要的事物；最不可能发生的事
words.ex: The last thing I want is to be late.
words.ex_cn: 我最不想做的就是迟到。
words.en: If you say that something is the last thing you would want, you are emphasizing that you definitely do not want it to happen or you definitely do not want to do it.

words.ex: This is the best bet to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这是赢得比赛的最佳选择。
words.en: The most advisable or likely course of action.

words.tr: phrase. 你最好的办法；你最好的选择
words.ex: Your best bet is to study harder for the test.
words.ex_cn: 你最好的选择是为考试更努力学习。
words.en: The most advisable or promising course of action or option.

words.ex: We went to a theme park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了一家主题公园。
words.en: A theme park is a type of amusement park that bases its structures and attractions around a central theme, often featuring multiple areas with different themes.

words.ex: He is honest through and through.
words.ex_cn: 他彻头彻尾是个诚实的人。
words.en: Completely and thoroughly; in every way.

words.tr: phrase. 使分秒在滴答声中溜走
words.ex: The seconds tick away on the clock.
words.ex_cn: 秒针在钟上一秒一秒地走着。
words.en: If you say that time ticks away, you mean that it passes, especially when you are waiting for something to happen or worrying about something.

words.tr: phrase. 使分秒在滴答声中溜走
words.ex: Time ticks by slowly when you are waiting.
words.ex_cn: 当你等待时，时间过得很慢。
words.en: If you say that time ticks by, you mean that it passes, especially when you are waiting for something to happen.

words.ex: He bought a train ticket at the ticket office.
words.ex_cn: 他在售票处买了一张火车票。
words.en: A ticket office is a place where tickets are sold to the public for admission to a theater, for travel on public transportation, etc.

words.tr: phrase. 使一致；使相联系；衔接
words.ex: He tries to tie in his story with the main topic.
words.ex_cn: 他试图将他的故事与主题联系起来。
words.en: To connect or link something closely with something else, making it relevant or related.

words.tr: phrase. 将……与……联系起来；使……卷入；把……打结系入
words.ex: Try to tie your study habits into your daily routine.
words.ex_cn: 试着把你的学习习惯与日常生活联系起来。
words.en: Connect or integrate one thing with another, often in a logical or systematic way.

words.tr: phrase. 和…有关系；把…联系起来
words.ex: We can tie the new idea in with the old plan.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以把新想法和旧计划联系起来。
words.en: Associate or link something with another related thing or idea.

words.ex: There is a time difference between New York and London.
words.ex_cn: 纽约和伦敦之间有时差。
words.en: The difference in time between two places, especially as it affects communication or travel.

words.ex: To be frank, I don't like this movie.
words.ex_cn: 老实说，我不喜欢这部电影。
words.en: Used to indicate that the speaker is being honest or straightforward in their statement.

words.ex: To my surprise, he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 让我惊讶的是，他通过了考试。
words.en: used to express that someone is surprised by something

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 从某种程度上来说
words.ex: He is late to some degree because of traffic.
words.ex_cn: 由于交通拥堵，他有点迟到。
words.en: To some extent; partly.

words.tr: phrase. 总之；总而言之；概括地说
words.ex: To sum up, he likes apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 总之，他喜欢苹果和橙子。
words.en: To provide a summary or conclusion of the main points.

words.w: to the best of one's knowledge
words.uk: tuː ðə best əv wʌnz ˈnɒlɪdʒ
words.us: tuː ðə best əv wʌnz ˈnɑːlɪdʒ
words.ex: To the best of my knowledge, the meeting is still on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 据我所知，会议仍在星期二举行。
words.en: As far as one knows or is aware.

words.tr: phrase. 切题；切中要害；中肯；扼要
words.ex: His answer was to the point.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答切中要点。
words.en: If you describe something that someone says or writes as to the point, you approve of it because it is relevant to the subject and does not contain anything unnecessary.

words.ex: The Great Wall is a famous tourist attraction.
words.ex_cn: 长城是一个著名的游览胜地。
words.en: A place of interest where tourists visit, typically for its inherent or exhibited natural or cultural value, historical significance, natural or built beauty, offering leisure, adventure, and amusement.

words.tr: phrase. 旅游目的地；旅游景点
words.ex: Paris is a popular tourist destination.
words.ex_cn: 巴黎是一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。
words.en: A tourist destination is a place that attracts tourists due to its cultural, historical, or natural significance.

words.ex: The car was towed away because it was parked illegally.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车被拖走了，因为它停在了不允许停车的地方。
words.en: To remove a vehicle by towing it, especially because it is illegally parked or causing an obstruction.

words.ex: She participates in track and field events.
words.ex_cn: 她参加田径项目。
words.en: Track and field refers to a group of athletic events that involve running, jumping, and throwing. It is a major category within the sport of athletics.

words.ex: He visited a trade fair to find new customers.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加贸易展以寻找新客户。
words.en: A trade fair is an exhibition where companies show and sell their products.

words.ex: He went to a trade show to find new customers.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了一个贸易展以寻找新客户。
words.en: A trade show is an exhibition organized so that companies in a specific industry can showcase and demonstrate their latest products and services, meet with industry partners and customers, study activities of rivals, and examine recent market trends and opportunities.

words.ex: He wants to trade his old bike in for a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他想把他的旧自行车换成新的。
words.en: Exchange an old item for a new one, often with a partial credit.

words.ex: He trades on his experience to get better deals.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借自己的经验来获得更好的交易。
words.en: To exploit or take advantage of something or someone's reputation, credibility, etc.

words.ex: He traded up his old car for a newer one.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧车换成了新车。
words.en: To exchange something you own for something of higher value or better quality.

words.tr: phrase. 交通堵塞；交通拥挤
words.ex: The city has too much traffic congestion during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市在高峰时段有严重的交通拥堵。
words.en: A situation in which there is too much traffic and movement is made very slow or stopped.

words.ex: He was late because of a traffic jam.
words.ex_cn: 他因为交通堵塞迟到了。
words.en: A traffic jam is a long line of vehicles that cannot move forward because there is too much traffic, or because the road is blocked by something.

words.ex: The traffic noise keeps me awake at night.
words.ex_cn: 交通噪音让我晚上睡不着。
words.en: Traffic noise refers to the sound produced by vehicles on the road, including cars, trucks, motorcycles, and buses, which can be a source of environmental pollution.

words.ex: He started to speak but then his voice trailed away.
words.ex_cn: 他开始说话，但随后声音逐渐变小，消失了。
words.en: To gradually become quieter or weaker and then disappear.

words.ex: He started to speak, but then his voice trailed off.
words.ex_cn: 他开始说话，但后来声音逐渐变小了。
words.en: If someone's voice trails off, it gradually becomes quieter and then stops.

words.ex: He started to speak, but then his voice trailed off.
words.ex_cn: 他开始说话，但后来声音逐渐变小了。
words.en: If someone's voice trails off, it gradually becomes quieter and then stops.

words.ex: The city improved its transportation system last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市去年改善了它的交通系统。
words.en: A transportation system is a network of vehicles, roads, and facilities that enable the movement of people and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: He booked his flight through a travel agency.
words.ex_cn: 他通过一家旅行社预订了航班。
words.en: A travel agency is a business that helps people plan and book trips and vacations.

words.tr: phrase. 轻装上阵；轻装旅行
words.ex: He travels light with just a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他只带一个背包轻装旅行。
words.en: To travel with minimal luggage or belongings, making movement and exploration easier.

words.ex: He used a traveller's cheque to pay for his hotel.
words.ex_cn: 他用旅行支票支付了酒店费用。
words.en: A traveller's cheque is a cheque for a fixed amount that can be used as a safe way of carrying money when you are travelling.

words.ex: He bought a traveller's check for his trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为旅行买了一张旅行支票。
words.en: A traveller's check is a preprinted, fixed-amount cheque designed to allow the person signing it to make an unconditional payment to someone else as a result of having paid the issuer for that privilege.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.ex: He tries his best to finish his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他尽力按时完成作业。
words.en: To make the greatest possible effort to do something.

words.ex: The teacher turned a blind eye to the student cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作弊行为故意视而不见。
words.en: to deliberately ignore something that you know is wrong or illegal

words.ex: He saw the mistake but decided to turn a blind eye to it.
words.ex_cn: 他看到了那个错误，但决定视而不见。
words.en: If you say that someone is turning a blind eye to something bad or illegal that is happening, you mean that you think they are pretending not to notice that it is happening so that they will not have to do anything about it.

words.ex: Please turn down the volume, it's too loud.
words.ex_cn: 请把音量调低，太大声了。
words.en: To refuse or reject an offer or request; to reduce the volume, temperature, or intensity of something.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.ex: He will return to school next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周将返回学校。
words.en: To go back to a previous state, place, or topic.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.ex: He wrote a tutorial paper on basic math skills.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于基础数学技能的指导论文。
words.en: A tutorial paper is a detailed written document that provides instruction or guidance on a particular subject, often used in educational settings to help students understand complex topics.

words.ex: There are twice as many apples as oranges in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里的苹果是橙子的两倍。
words.en: used to say that one amount is two times as large as another

words.ex: The sun gives out ultraviolet radiation.
words.ex_cn: 太阳发出紫外线辐射。
words.en: Ultraviolet radiation is a type of energy produced by the sun and some artificial sources, which can cause damage to the skin and eyes.

words.ex: He is uncertain about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are uncertain about something, you do not know what is true, what is going to happen, or what you should do.

words.ex: He works well under pressure.
words.ex_cn: 他在压力下工作得很好。
words.en: Being subjected to stress or coercion.

words.ex: He works well under stress.
words.ex_cn: 他在压力下工作得很好。
words.en: Experiencing mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate student at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate student is a student in a university or college who has not yet received a first degree.

words.ex: He pays the union fee every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每个月支付工会会费。
words.en: A fee paid by members of a union to support its activities and operations.

words.tr: phrase. 普及教育；全民教育
words.ex: The government wants universal education for all children.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望为所有儿童提供普及教育。
words.en: Universal education refers to the concept in which education is provided to all citizens, typically by the government, without discrimination.

words.tr: phrase. 多达；直到；在于…；能胜任
words.ex: The box can hold up to ten books.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子最多能放十本书。
words.en: used to say that something is the responsibility of someone or that someone has the ability to decide something

words.tr: phrase. 上层社会， 贵族阶层
words.ex: He was born into the upper class.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在上层阶级。
words.en: The upper class refers to the group of people in a society who have the highest social rank and who are usually rich and powerful.

words.ex: The upper limit of the tank is 100 liters.
words.ex_cn: 这个水箱的上限是100升。
words.en: The highest level or amount that is allowed or possible.

words.ex: The company has a vacant position for a manager.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个经理的空缺职位。
words.en: A position or job that is available because someone has left or a new role has been created.

words.ex: He drinks hot water from a vacuum flask.
words.ex_cn: 他从保温瓶里喝热水。
words.en: A vacuum flask is a container which is used to keep hot drinks hot and cold drinks cold. It has double walls with a vacuum between them, which prevents heat from passing through.

words.ex: He studied various aspects of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他研究了这个问题的各个方面。
words.en: Different parts or facets of a subject or situation.

words.ex: The price of fruit may vary with the season.
words.ex_cn: 水果的价格可能随季节而变化。
words.en: If something varies with something else, it changes depending on that other thing.

words.ex: The virgin forest has no roads or trees cut down.
words.ex_cn: 原始森林里没有道路，也没有被砍伐的树木。
words.en: A virgin forest is an area of forest that has never been logged or disturbed by human activity.

words.ex: He is wearing a headset to experience virtual reality.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着头盔体验虚拟现实。
words.en: Virtual reality is an artificial environment that is created with software and presented to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and accepts it as a real environment.

words.tr: phrase. 职业学校；技术学校
words.ex: He went to a vocational school to learn car repair.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一所职业学校学习修车。
words.en: A vocational school is an educational institution designed to provide vocational education or technical skills required to perform the tasks of a particular and specific job.

words.tr: phrase. 志愿者组织；民办团体
words.ex: He works for a voluntary organization that helps children.
words.ex_cn: 他为一个帮助儿童的志愿组织工作。
words.en: A voluntary organization is a group that operates without the primary goal of making a profit and is often involved in charitable, educational, or other socially beneficial activities.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: I wake up at seven every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点醒来。
words.en: To stop sleeping and become conscious, or to make someone stop sleeping.

words.tr: phrase. 顺手带走；轻易取胜
words.ex: He walked away with my pen by mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心顺手拿走了我的钢笔。
words.en: To win something easily or to take something without difficulty.

words.ex: She uses the washing machine every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每星期天都用洗衣机。
words.en: A washing machine is a machine that washes clothes, sheets, and other items.

words.ex: The city improves waste disposal to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了废物处理以保护环境。
words.en: The process of getting rid of waste materials, especially to prevent harm to the environment.

words.ex: He watches for the bus every morning at 7.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上七点守候公交车。
words.en: To be alert and look out for something or someone.

words.ex: Watch out for the falling tree!
words.ex_cn: 小心掉下来的树！
words.en: To be careful or cautious, especially in order to avoid danger.

words.ex: Vitamin C is a water-soluble vitamin.
words.ex_cn: 维生素C是一种水溶性维生素。
words.en: A vitamin that can dissolve in water and is carried to the body's tissues but is not stored in the body.

words.ex: His guess is way off base.
words.ex_cn: 他的猜测完全错了。
words.en: If you say that someone is way off base, you mean that they are completely wrong about something.

words.ex: He typed the website address into the browser.
words.ex_cn: 他把网站地址输入到浏览器中。
words.en: The location of a website on the Internet, usually starting with 'http://' or 'https://', followed by the domain name.

words.ex: They whispered their wedding vow under the trees.
words.ex_cn: 他们在树下轻声说出婚礼誓言。
words.en: A wedding vow is a promise made by the bride and groom to each other during the wedding ceremony, expressing their commitment and love.

words.ex: He weighs the pros and cons before making a decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在做决定前权衡利弊。
words.en: To consider the advantages and disadvantages before making a decision.

words.ex: He does weight lifting every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上举重。
words.en: Weight lifting is a sport in which the competitor who can lift the heaviest weight wins.

words.ex: Well done! You solved the problem correctly.
words.ex_cn: 做得好！你正确地解决了这个问题。
words.en: Used to express approval or praise for someone who has done something successfully or achieved something.

words.ex: He wiped out the board with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布把板擦掉了。
words.en: To completely destroy, remove, or eliminate something or someone.

words.ex: The town has a population of 5,000 people.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有五千人口。
words.en: Indicates the number of residents in a particular area or country.

words.ex: He solved the math problem with the help of his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师的帮助下解决了这道数学题。
words.en: With the assistance or support of someone or something.

words.ex: He is without question the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: If you do something without question, you do it without arguing or asking why.

words.ex: He uses word processing to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用文字处理来写作业。
words.en: Word processing is the production, storage, and manipulation of text on a computer or word processor.

words.ex: He does data processing for the company.
words.ex_cn: 他为公司做数据处理。
words.en: The manipulation of data by a computer to perform operations such as sorting, classifying, calculating, summarizing, and storing.

words.tr: phrase. 算出；解决；锻炼；进展（顺利）
words.ex: I can work out the answer with a calculator.
words.ex_cn: 我可以用计算器算出答案。
words.en: If you work out a solution to a problem or mystery, you think about it and find a solution. If you work out the answer to a mathematical problem, you calculate it. If a plan or situation works out, it happens or progresses in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 完成；解决；逐渐穿过；穿透
words.ex: He worked through all the math problems before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他在晚饭前完成了所有的数学题。
words.en: To deal with or solve a problem or task completely or thoroughly.

words.ex: He has much working experience in sales.
words.ex_cn: 他在销售方面有丰富的经验。
words.en: Working experience refers to the knowledge or skill acquired by working in a particular job or field.

words.ex: It is worth doing the homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天做作业是值得的。
words.en: If something is worth doing, it is enjoyable or useful, and you should spend time doing it.

words.ex: He will write back to his friend tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会给朋友回信。
words.en: Reply to a letter, email, or message.

words.tr: phrase. 详细描写；资产账面价值的有意增加；写文章赞扬
words.ex: He will write up the report tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会写出这份报告。
words.en: To write something in a detailed or formal way, especially a report or account of something.

words.tr: phrase. 但凡你想得起的；不管什么
words.ex: We have apples, bananas, you name it.
words.ex_cn: 我们有苹果、香蕉，等等所有东西。
words.en: You use 'you name it' to indicate that a list of things could be extended indefinitely because there are so many possibilities.

words.ex: The students stayed in a youth hostel during their trip.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在旅行期间住在青年旅舍。
words.en: A youth hostel is a place where young people, especially those who are traveling, can stay cheaply for short periods of time. It usually provides dormitory-style accommodation and shared facilities.
